daas-irab:37-37.t: ﴿فَمَنْ﴾: مَن is an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject); the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿أَظْلَمُ﴾: its khabar (predicate). ﴿مِمَّنِ﴾: [مَن] is a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive (majrūr) by مِن; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أظلم. ﴿افْتَرى عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِباً﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; كذبا is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. The clause ﴿أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِآياتِهِ﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَنالُهُمْ نَصِيبُهُمْ مِنَ الْكِتابِ﴾: an imperfect verb, its object and its fāʿil (agent); من الكتاب is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from نصيبهم. The verbal clause is the khabar of أولئك. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and of the genitive. ﴿إِذا جاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُنا﴾: a past verb, its object and its agent; the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation). ﴿يَتَوَفَّوْنَهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, its agent and its object; the clause is in the position of the accusative (manṣūb) as ḥāl. The clause ﴿قالُوا﴾ has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive conditional. ﴿أَيْنَ﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as an adverb of place, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿ما كُنْتُمْ﴾: ما is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ; كنتم: kāna, and the tāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ is its khabar. ﴿قالُوا﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿ضَلُّوا عَنَّا﴾ is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl); the clause ﴿شَهِدُوا عَلى أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾ is conjoined. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾: anna and its noun, and the clause ﴿كانُوا كافِرِينَ﴾ is its khabar. Anna and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by a preposition — "they testified against themselves to their disbelief" — and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to شهدوا.

daas-irab:38-38.t:
﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿ادْخُلُوا﴾: an imperative verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿فِي أُمَمٍ﴾ are attached; it is indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قَدْ خَلَتْ﴾: قد is a particle of realization, and [خلت] is a past verb to which the following preposition and its genitive noun are attached; it is indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the clause is in the position of the genitive (majrūr) as an adjective (ṣifa) of أمم. ﴿مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of أمم. ﴿فِي النَّارِ﴾: attached to the verb ادخلوا. ﴿كُلَّما﴾: temporal adverbial, conveying the sense of a condition; the clause ﴿دَخَلَتْ أُمَّةٌ﴾ is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation), and the clause ﴿لَعَنَتْ أُخْتَها﴾ has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive conditional. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and of the genitive. ﴿إِذَا﴾: a non-jussive conditional adverb.
﴿ادَّارَكُوا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is its agent. ﴿فِيها﴾: attached to اداركوا. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿قالَتْ﴾: a past verb. ﴿أُخْراهُمْ﴾: agent, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied on the alif because of impossibility (taʿadhdhur); هم is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿لِأُولاهُمْ﴾: a genitive noun, the sign of its genitive being the kasra implied on the alif because of impossibility; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb قالت. The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive conditional.
﴿رَبَّنا﴾: the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative (manṣūb); نا is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), indeclinable on the kasra. ﴿أَضَلُّونا﴾: a past verb, its agent and its object, and the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿فَآتِهِمْ﴾: a verb of supplication, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, since it is weak-final; the hāʾ is its first object and the mīm is for the plural. The fāʾ before it is the faṣīḥa. ﴿عَذاباً﴾: its second object. ﴿ضِعْفاً﴾: an adjective of عذاب. ﴿مِنَ النَّارِ﴾: attached to an omitted second adjective of عذاب; the clause ﴿آتهم﴾ has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied condition. ﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِكُلٍّ﴾: attached to an omitted fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿ضِعْفٌ﴾, and the clause is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of قال. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾: a particle of rectification (istidrāk), and the wāw is circumstantial.
The clause ﴿لا تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl.

daas-irab:39-39.t: ﴿وَقالَتْ أُولاهُمْ لِأُخْراهُمْ﴾: its i'rab has preceded in the previous verse. ﴿فَما﴾: the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida); ما is negative. ﴿كانَ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَكُمْ عَلَيْنا﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of kāna. ﴿مِنْ فَضْلٍ﴾: مِن is a redundant preposition; فضل is genitive in form and nominative in position as the noun of kāna; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl), a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَذُوقُوا﴾: the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa, and the verbal clause ﴿ذوقوا الْعَذابَ﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position: "if the saying has taken place, then taste the punishment ...". ﴿بِما﴾: ما is relative or maṣdarī. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), and the clause ﴿تَكْسِبُونَ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of كنتم.

daas-irab:40-40.t:
﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآياتِنا﴾: الذين is a relative noun, the noun of inna, and the clause after it is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿اسْتَكْبَرُوا عَنْها﴾ is conjoined to it. ﴿لا تُفَتَّحُ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and ﴿أَبْوابُ﴾ is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿وَلا يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; لا is negative, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿حَتَّى يَلِجَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after حتى; the interpreted maṣdar formed from the verb and the maṣdarī particle before it is in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يدخلون. ﴿الْجَمَلُ﴾: agent. ﴿فِي سَمِّ﴾: attached to the verb يلج. ﴿الْخِياطِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾: the demonstrative is in the position of the genitive by the kāf, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar: ﴿نَجْزِي الْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾ "a recompense like the recompense of those who denied ...".
﴿الْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:41-41.t: ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) ﴿مِهادٌ﴾. ﴿مِنْ جَهَنَّمَ﴾: attached to an omitted second khabar. The nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), or resumptive with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ﴾: attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿غَواشٍ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative with the ḍamma implied on the dropped yāʾ. ﴿وَكَذلِكَ نَجْزِي الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: its i'rab has preceded in the previous verse. The clause ﴿وَمِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ﴾ is conjoined.

daas-irab:42-42.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of عملوا, accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; the verbal clause is conjoined. ﴿لا نُكَلِّفُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and لا is negative. ﴿نَفْساً﴾: first object. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿وُسْعَها﴾: second object; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "we" (نحن), and the clause is parenthetical. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَصْحابُ﴾: khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause is the khabar of الذي [Translator's note: so in the source; the relative noun in the verse is الذين]. ﴿الْجَنَّةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿هُمْ﴾: a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar. ﴿خالِدُونَ﴾: its khabar, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:43-43.t:
﴿وَنَزَعْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي صُدُورِهِمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْ غِلٍّ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause is conjoined. ﴿تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهِمُ الْأَنْهارُ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and الأنهار is its agent; the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl. ﴿وَقالُوا﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿الْحَمْدُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: attached to its omitted khabar (predicate), and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive as an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿هَدانا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied on the alif because of impossibility (taʿadhdhur); its agent is "he" and نا is its object. ﴿لِهذا﴾: attached to هدانا. ﴿وَما﴾: ما is negative and the wāw is resumptive. ﴿كُنَّا﴾: kāna, and نا is its noun. ﴿لِنَهْتَدِيَ﴾: the lām is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd); نهتدي is accusative by an implied an after the lām of denial; the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb after it is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar: "and we were not ones made able to be guided"; the clause is resumptive.
﴿لَوْلا﴾: a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿أَنْ﴾: a maṣdarī particle governing the accusative. ﴿هَدانَا اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb, its object, and the name of Majesty is its agent; the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb is in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the khabar is omitted after لولا: "were it not that Allah's guidance exists ...". ﴿لَقَدْ﴾: the lām occurs in the response to an oath; قد is a particle of realization. ﴿جاءَتْ رُسُلُ رَبِّنا﴾: a past verb, its agent and a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the response to an implied oath.
﴿وَنُودُوا﴾: a passive past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿أَنْ﴾: explicative, or lightened from anna.
﴿تِلْكُمُ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable on the kasra, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance, the kāf is a particle of address, and the mīm is for the plural. ﴿الْجَنَّةُ﴾: badal (substitute) or khabar, and the clause ﴿أُورِثْتُمُوها﴾ is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl; if الجنة is parsed as badal, then the clause أورثتموها is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿أُورِثْتُمُوها﴾: a passive past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the tāʾ of the agent; the tāʾ is the deputy agent, the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural, the wāw is for the lengthening of the ḍamma, and ها is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِما﴾: ما is relative, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to the verb. ﴿كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ﴾: kāna, the tāʾ is its noun, and the clause is its khabar.

daas-irab:44-44.t: ﴿وَنادى أَصْحابُ الْجَنَّةِ أَصْحابَ النَّارِ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the implied fatḥa, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ قَدْ وَجَدْنا ما وَعَدَنا﴾: أن is explicative, or lightened, its noun being the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and the clause after it is the khabar (predicate); the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by an omitted preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb نادى: "they called out with [the announcement of] finding what was promised ...". Taking it as explicative, the clause after it is explicative with no grammatical position. ما is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause وعدنا is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿رَبُّنا﴾: agent. ﴿حَقًّا﴾: second object. ﴿فَهَلْ﴾: هل is an interrogative particle and the fāʾ is resumptive; the clause ﴿وَجَدْتُمْ﴾ is resumptive. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its agent. ﴿نَعَمْ﴾: a particle of answer, and the clause ﴿فَأَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌ﴾ is resumptive after the fāʾ. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾: an adverb of time [Translator's note: so in the source; بين is usually classed as an adverb of place] attached to أذن. ﴿أَنْ﴾: lightened or explicative. ﴿لَعْنَةُ﴾: the khabar of the lightened an, or a mubtadaʾ (subject) after the explicative an. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَلَى الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: attached to an omitted khabar. The nominal clause is explicative, or the interpreted maṣdar formed from the lightened an and the verb is in the position of the genitive. The second an is like the first, and the clause is its khabar.

daas-irab:45-45.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥ, in the position of the genitive as an adjective (ṣifa) of الظالمين. ﴿عَنْ سَبِيلِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb يصد. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause ﴿يَصُدُّونَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَيَبْغُونَها﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and ها its object. ﴿عِوَجاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the wāw is circumstantial. ﴿بِالْآخِرَةِ﴾: attached to the khabar (predicate) after them, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl. ﴿كافِرُونَ﴾: khabar.

daas-irab:46-46.t: ﴿وَبَيْنَهُما﴾: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation), ما is for the dual, and the wāw is resumptive. ﴿حِجابٌ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿وَعَلَى الْأَعْرافِ﴾: attached to an omitted fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿رِجالٌ﴾, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَعْرِفُونَ كُلًّا﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿بِسِيماهُمْ﴾ are attached; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and كلا its object; the clause is in the position of the nominative as an adjective (ṣifa) of رجال. ﴿وَنادَوْا أَصْحابَ﴾: a past verb, its agent and its object; the clause is resumptive after the wāw. ﴿الْجَنَّةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَنْ﴾: lightened or explicative, like an in the previous verses. ﴿سَلامٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: attached to its omitted khabar, and the clause is explicative or predicative. ﴿لَمْ﴾: jussive. ﴿يَدْخُلُوها﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the agent and ها the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿يَطْمَعُونَ﴾ is the khabar; the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) after the circumstantial wāw.

daas-irab:47-47.t:
﴿وَإِذا﴾: إذا is an adverb that contains the sense of a condition. ﴿صُرِفَتْ أَبْصارُهُمْ﴾: a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿تِلْقاءَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) صرفت. ﴿أَصْحابِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿النَّارِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation) after the conditional إذا. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative with the fatḥa; نا is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿لا تَجْعَلْنا﴾: an imperfect verb of supplication, jussive (majzūm); نا is an attached pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and لا is the prohibitive lā governing the jussive. ﴿مَعَ الْقَوْمِ﴾: attached to تجعلنا. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa), genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is a mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:48-48.t: ﴿وَنادى أَصْحابُ﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْأَعْرافِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿رِجالًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَعْرِفُونَهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, its agent and its object; the mīm is for the masculine plural, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿بِسِيماهُمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿قالُوا﴾: the clause is explicative. ﴿ما أَغْنى عَنْكُمْ جَمْعُكُمْ﴾: a past verb to which the following preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and جمعكم is its agent; ما is negative, with no governing effect, and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَما كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; ما is maṣdarī, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from it and the verb after it is conjoined to جمعكم: "neither your gathering nor your arrogance availed you". The clause تستكبرون is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of كنتم.

daas-irab:49-49.t:
﴿أَهؤُلاءِ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh) and the hamza is interrogative.
﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on the fatḥ, in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate). ﴿أَقْسَمْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿لا يَنالُهُمُ اللَّهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the hāʾ is its object and the name of Majesty its agent; the clause has no grammatical position, being the response to the oath, and لا is negative with no governing effect. ﴿ادْخُلُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its agent and ﴿الْجَنَّةَ﴾ its object; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb: "Allah says to them: enter the Garden ...". ﴿لا خَوْفٌ﴾: لا is negative, and [خوف] is a nominative mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلا أَنْتُمْ﴾: أنتم is a detached pronoun in the position of [the nominative as] mubtadaʾ, and لا is negative; the clause ﴿تَحْزَنُونَ﴾ is its khabar, and the nominal clause ولا أنتم ... is conjoined ...

daas-irab:50-50.t:
﴿وَنادى أَصْحابُ النَّارِ أَصْحابَ الْجَنَّةِ﴾: a past verb; the first أصحاب is its fāʿil (agent) and the second أصحاب its object; النار is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) and الجنة is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ﴾: lightened from anna, or explicative. ﴿أَفِيضُوا﴾: an imperative verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun علينا are attached. ﴿مِنَ الْماءِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) أفيضوا. ﴿أَوْ﴾: conjunction. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: composed of مِن and the relative ما, and the verbal clause ﴿رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿قالُوا﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: inna, and the name of Majesty is its noun; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause ﴿حَرَّمَهُما﴾ is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate). ﴿عَلَى الْكافِرِينَ﴾: attached to the verb before them.

daas-irab:144-144.t: ﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿يا مُوسى﴾: the one addressed (munādā), a single proper noun. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿اصْطَفَيْتُكَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna. The clause of inna, its noun and its khabar is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿عَلَى النَّاسِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿بِرِسالاتِي﴾: a genitive (majrūr) noun, the sign of its genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person; the yāʾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to اصطفيتك. ﴿وَبِكَلامِي﴾: conjoined (ʿaṭf). ﴿فَخُذْ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition). ﴿خذ﴾: an imperative. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied non-jussive condition: "if that is so, then take what I have given you". ﴿آتَيْتُكَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the kāf is its mafʿūl; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما. ﴿وَكُنْ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperative verb, its noun omitted, its implied form being "أنت". ﴿مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:145-145.t:
﴿وَكَتَبْنا﴾: a past verb, to which each of the prepositional phrases ﴿لَهُ﴾ and ﴿فِي الْأَلْواحِ، مِنْ كُلِّ..﴾ is attached (mutaʿalliq); and نا is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). The clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿مَوْعِظَةً﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿وَتَفْصِيلًا﴾: conjoined. ﴿لِكُلِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تفصيلا. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَخُذْها﴾: an imperative verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis of an implied condition.
The fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِقُوَّةٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خذها; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied non-jussive condition. ﴿وَأْمُرْ قَوْمَكَ﴾:
an imperative verb and its mafʿūl; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, and the kāf is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَأْخُذُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the command (jawāb al-ṭalab), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿بِأَحْسَنِها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يأخذوا; the clause is the object of the imperative verb أأمر. «[Translator's note: so in the source, "أأمر"; presumably the verb أْمُرْ is meant.]» ﴿سَأُرِيكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the fāʿil is "أنت" «[Translator's note: so in the source; the speaker here is the first person, so the implied fāʿil would be أنا.]», and the kāf is its mafʿūl; the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural. ﴿دارَ﴾: its second mafʿūl; the underlying form is "مصير دار الفاسقين" (the end of the abode of the transgressors).
﴿الْفاسِقِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:146-146.t: ﴿سَأَصْرِفُ عَنْ آياتِيَ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: the relative noun is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنا"; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿يَتَكَبَّرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and fāʿil. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يتكبرون; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿الْحَقِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: conditional. ﴿يَرَوْا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn, because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the wāw is the fāʿil. And ﴿كُلَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿آيَةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and لا is negating, with no governing effect. ﴿بِها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition not joined to the fāʾ or to the إذا of surprise. ﴿وَإِنْ يَرَوْا سَبِيلَ الرُّشْدِ لا يَتَّخِذُوهُ سَبِيلًا﴾: the i'rab of the beginning of the verse has preceded; لا يتخذوه سبيلا: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its two mafʿūls; the clause has no grammatical position, like the one before it. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf is a particle of address. ﴿بِأَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوا﴾: أن and what follows it are, by interpretation, a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive governed by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَكانُوا﴾: kāna and its noun. ﴿عَنْها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar ﴿غافِلِينَ﴾; the clause is conjoined to the khabar clause كذبوا.

daas-irab:147-147.t:
﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَذَّبُوا بِآياتِنا﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلِقاءِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿الْآخِرَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿حَبِطَتْ أَعْمالُهُمْ﴾: a past verb and fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ الذين.
﴿هَلْ﴾: an interrogative particle conveying negation. ﴿يُجْزَوْنَ﴾: an imperfect verb in the passive, and the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), which is the first object. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna, and the wāw is its noun; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as its khabar.

daas-irab:148-148.t:
﴿وَاتَّخَذَ قَوْمُ﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent). ﴿مُوسى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) اتخذ; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿مِنْ حُلِيِّهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿عِجْلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿جَسَداً﴾: badal (substitute), accusative. ﴿لَهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿خُوارٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as a ṣifa (adjective) of جسدا.
﴿أَلَمْ يَرَوْا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; لم is a jussive particle; يروا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنَّهُ﴾: أن, and the hāʾ is its noun. ﴿لا يُكَلِّمُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is "هو", and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl; the mīm is for the masculine plural, and لا is negating; the clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar of أن; and أن with what follows it stands in place of the two objects of يروا.
﴿وَلا يَهْدِيهِمْ سَبِيلًا﴾: an imperfect verb and its two objects, and لا is negating; the clause is conjoined. ﴿اتَّخَذُوهُ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, with its fāʿil and its mafʿūl; the clause is resumptive, and the clause كانوا ظالمين is conjoined.

daas-irab:149-149.t:
﴿وَلَمَّا﴾: adverbial (ẓarfiyya) and conditional. ﴿سُقِطَ﴾: a past verb in the passive. ﴿فِي أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾: a genitive (majrūr) noun, the sign of its genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, its appearance prevented by heaviness; the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَرَأَوْا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied on the alif that was deleted because of the meeting of two sukūns, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾: أن and its noun, and the clause ﴿قَدْ ضَلُّوا﴾ is in the position of the nominative as its khabar (predicate). أن with what follows it stands in place of the two objects of رأوا. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿لَئِنْ﴾: the lām prepares for an oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and إن is conditional. ﴿لَمْ﴾: a jussive particle.
﴿يَرْحَمْنا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and its mafʿūl (object), and ﴿رَبُّنا﴾ is its fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَيَغْفِرْ﴾: conjoined. ﴿لَنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يغفر. ﴿لَنَكُونَنَّ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the lām occurs in the answer to the oath; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "نحن"; the clause has no grammatical position as the answer to the oath. The apodosis of the condition is omitted because the answer to the oath indicates it. ﴿مِنَ الْخاسِرِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of the incomplete verb.

daas-irab:150-150.t: ﴿وَلَمَّا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لما is the temporal (ḥīniyya) conditional لمّا. ﴿رَجَعَ مُوسى إِلى قَوْمِهِ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and موسى is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿غَضْبانَ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَسِفاً﴾: a second ḥāl. ﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is the answer to لما, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِئْسَما﴾: a past verb for expressing blame, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿ما﴾: an indefinite qualified noun (nakira mawṣūfa), indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as tamyīz (specification). ﴿خَلَفْتُمُونِي﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the vowelled tāʾ of the agent; the mīm is for the masculine plural, and the ḍamma vowel of the mīm has been lengthened into a wāw; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ṣifa (adjective) of ما. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِي﴾: a noun, genitive (majrūr) by the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿أَعَجِلْتُمْ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَمْرَ﴾: its mafʿūl. ﴿رَبِّكُمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿وَأَلْقَى الْأَلْواحَ﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl, and its fāʿil is "هو"; the clause is conjoined to قال. ﴿وَأَخَذَ بِرَأْسِ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿أَخِيهِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is one of the five nouns; the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَجُرُّهُ إِلَيْهِ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl; the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿ابْنَ أُمَّ﴾: two parts, both indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as vocative (nidāʾ); or ابن is the one addressed (munādā) and أمّ is muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the kasra implied on the deleted alif that was converted from a yāʾ; the fatḥa indicates the deleted alif, as in a munādā annexed to the yāʾ of the first person. ﴿إِنَّ الْقَوْمَ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿اسْتَضْعَفُونِي﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl; the clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of inna, and the clause إن القوم is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كادُوا﴾: كاد and its noun. ﴿يَقْتُلُونَنِي﴾: an imperfect verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of the accusative as khabar of كادوا, and the clause كادوا is conjoined. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and لا is the prohibitive لا, governing the jussive. ﴿تُشْمِتْ بِيَ الْأَعْداءَ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and الأعداء is its mafʿūl; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and لا is prohibitive. ﴿تَجْعَلْنِي﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive; the nūn is for protection, the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "أنت". ﴿مَعَ الْقَوْمِ﴾: an adverb of place, and القوم is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: a ṣifa, genitive, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:151-151.t:
﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), with the vocative particle يا omitted. ﴿اغْفِرْ لِي﴾: a verb of supplication to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and its fāʿil is "أنت". ﴿وَلِأَخِي﴾: a noun, genitive (majrūr) by the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined. ﴿وَأَدْخِلْنا فِي رَحْمَتِكَ﴾: a verb of supplication to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and نا is its fāʿil «[Translator's note: so in the source; نا here is the object, the fāʿil being "أنت".]»; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَأَنْتَ﴾: أنت is a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿أَرْحَمُ﴾: khabar (predicate).
﴿الرَّاحِمِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:152-152.t:
﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna. ﴿اتَّخَذُوا الْعِجْلَ﴾: a past verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the second object is omitted, i.e. "اتخذوا العجل إلها" (they took the calf as a god); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿سَيَنالُهُمْ غَضَبٌ﴾: an imperfect verb, its mafʿūl and its fāʿil; the sīn is for the future, and the clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) غضب. ﴿وَذِلَّةٌ﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَذِلَّةٌ فِي الْحَياةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ذلة. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: a ṣifa (adjective), genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa implied on the alif. «[Translator's note: so in the source; the implied vowel would be the kasra.]» ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾: the kāf is a preposition, and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ṣifa of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object): "نجزي المفترين جزاء كائنا كذلك الجزاء" (We recompense the fabricators with a recompense like that recompense). ﴿نَجْزِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the implied ḍamma, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "نحن". ﴿الْمُفْتَرِينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).

daas-irab:153-153.t:
﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the wāw is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).
﴿عَمِلُوا السَّيِّئاتِ﴾: a past verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative by the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿ثُمَّ تابُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and ثم is a conjunction. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them; the clause is conjoined, and likewise the clause آمنوا. ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَغَفُورٌ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar (predicate), and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).
And ﴿رَحِيمٌ﴾: a second khabar; the clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ الذين.

daas-irab:154-154.t:
﴿وَلَمَّا﴾: adverbial (ẓarfiyya) and conditional, and the wāw is resumptive. ﴿سَكَتَ عَنْ مُوسَى الْغَضَبُ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and الغضب is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); and the clause ﴿أَخَذَ الْأَلْواحَ﴾ has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَفِي نُسْخَتِها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿هُدىً﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَرَحْمَةٌ﴾: conjoined. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun) رحمة. ﴿هُمْ﴾: a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِرَبِّهِمْ﴾: the lām is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition.
﴿ربهم﴾: a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَرْهَبُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. The clause is the khabar of هم; and the clause هم لربهم يرهبون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:155-155.t: ﴿وَاخْتارَ مُوسى﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent). ﴿قَوْمَهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative by removal of the preposition; its original form is "من قومه". The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. «[Translator's note: so in the source.]» ﴿سَبْعِينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the yāʾ. ﴿رَجُلًا﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿لِمِيقاتِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb اختار; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: لما is adverbial (ẓarfiyya) and conditional, and the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿أَخَذَتْهُمُ﴾: a past verb with the tāʾ of the feminine, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl. ﴿الرَّجْفَةُ﴾: its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿قالَ﴾: the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to لما. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), annexed. The vocative clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لَوْ﴾: a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿شِئْتَ﴾: a past verb and fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, being the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿أَهْلَكْتَهُمْ﴾: a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾: an adverb of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the genitive, because it is cut off from annexation; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَإِيَّايَ﴾: a detached pronoun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the hāʾ in أهلكتهم; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿أَتُهْلِكُنا﴾: an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl, and the fāʿil is "أنت"; the hamza is for interrogation. ﴿بِما﴾: ما is a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive governed by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb. ﴿فَعَلَ السُّفَهاءُ﴾: a past verb and fāʿil. ﴿مِنَّا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from السفهاء; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا فِتْنَتُكَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); إن is negating with the meaning of ما, and إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); the clause is resumptive, together with the speech. ﴿تُضِلُّ بِها مَنْ تَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the relative noun is its mafʿūl; the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl, and the clause تشاء is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَتَهْدِي مَنْ تَشاءُ﴾: conjoined. ﴿أَنْتَ وَلِيُّنا﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar. ﴿فَاغْفِرْ لَنا﴾: a verb of supplication to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and its fāʿil is "أنت"; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition). The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied condition. ﴿وَارْحَمْنا﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar. ﴿الْغافِرِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl after the wāw of circumstance, or it is resumptive.

daas-irab:51-51.t:
﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive (majrūr) as an adjective (ṣifa) of الكافرين. ﴿اتَّخَذُوا دِينَهُمْ لَهْواً﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its two objects.
﴿وَلَعِباً﴾: conjoined, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَغَرَّتْهُمُ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥ; the tāʾ is for the feminine, the hāʾ is its object, and the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿الْحَياةُ﴾: agent, and ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ is a nominative adjective; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَالْيَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb ﴿نَنْساهُمْ﴾; the fāʾ is resumptive and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿كَما﴾: the kāf is a preposition and ما is maṣdarī; together with the verb after it, it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by the kāf, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted maṣdar: "We forget them with a forgetting like their forgetting of the meeting of this Day of theirs". ﴿نَسُوا﴾:
a past verb and its agent. ﴿لِقاءَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَوْمِهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation). ﴿هذا﴾: a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as badal (substitute) or adjective. ﴿وَما كانُوا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw is its noun; ما is maṣdarī, and the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to the preceding maṣdar: "and their being ones who reject". ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾: attached to the verb after them. The clause ﴿يَجْحَدُونَ﴾ is in the position of the accusative (manṣūb) as khabar (predicate).

daas-irab:52-52.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath, and قد is a particle of realization. ﴿جِئْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb; نا is its fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ its object. ﴿بِكِتابٍ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿فَصَّلْناهُ﴾: a past verb, its agent and its object; the clause is in the position of the genitive (majrūr) as an adjective (ṣifa) of كتاب, and the clause ﴿جِئْناهُمْ﴾ has no grammatical position, being the response to the oath. ﴿عَلى عِلْمٍ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of فصلناه, i.e., "We detailed it, comprising knowledge". ﴿هُدىً﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) or ḥāl. ﴿وَرَحْمَةً﴾: conjoined. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾: attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun) هدى or to رحمة. The clause ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ is in the position of the genitive as an adjective of قوم.

daas-irab:53-53.t: ﴿هَلْ﴾: an interrogative particle. ﴿يَنْظُرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿تَأْوِيلَهُ﴾: its object. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction [Translator's note: so in the source; this repeats the previous item]. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb يقول. ﴿يَأْتِي تَأْوِيلُهُ﴾: an imperfect verb and its agent; the clause is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation). ﴿يَقُولُ الَّذِينَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the relative noun is its agent. ﴿نَسُوهُ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma; the wāw is its agent and the hāʾ its object. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a preposition. ﴿قَبْلُ﴾: an adverb of time, indeclinable on the ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation, in the position of the genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb نسوه. ﴿قَدْ جاءَتْ رُسُلُ﴾: a past verb and its agent; the tāʾ is for the feminine; قد is a particle of realization. ﴿رَبِّنا﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and نا is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾: attached to the verb جاءت. ﴿فَهَلْ﴾: هل is an interrogative particle and the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿لَنا﴾: attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿مِنْ شُفَعاءَ﴾: a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as mubtadaʾ (subject); it is genitive with the fatḥa, being a diptote, a feminine noun ending in an extended alif; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَيَشْفَعُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the fāʾ of causation, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the agent, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb is conjoined to شفعاء: "have we any intercessors, and so intercession from them?". ﴿لَنا﴾: attached to the verb. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿نُرَدُّ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) implied as "we" (نحن); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, the implied sense being: "are there any intercessors, or will we be sent back?". ﴿فَنَعْمَلَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after the fāʾ of causation, and the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿غَيْرَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿كُنَّا﴾: kāna, and نا is its noun; the clause ﴿نَعْمَلُ﴾ is its khabar, and the clause كنا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of realization. ﴿خَسِرُوا﴾: a past verb and agent. ﴿أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the relative noun ﴿ما﴾ is its agent; the clause ﴿كانُوا﴾ is the ṣila, and the clause ﴿يَفْتَرُونَ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as khabar.

daas-irab:54-54.t: ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun, and the name of Majesty is its khabar (predicate). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of the nominative as an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿خَلَقَ السَّماواتِ﴾: a past verb and its object. ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾: conjoined. ﴿فِي سِتَّةِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb خلق. ﴿أَيَّامٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction, and the clause ﴿اسْتَوى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ﴾ is conjoined. ﴿يُغْشِي﴾: an imperfect verb. ﴿اللَّيْلَ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿النَّهارَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial); likewise the clause ﴿يَطْلُبُهُ حَثِيثاً﴾ is a ḥāl. ﴿وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ وَالنُّجُومَ﴾: conjoined to السموات والأرض ... ﴿مُسَخَّراتٍ﴾: ḥāl, accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿بِأَمْرِهِ﴾: attached to مسخرات. ﴿أَلا﴾: an opening particle (istiftāḥ). ﴿لَهُ﴾: attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿الْخَلْقُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَالْأَمْرُ﴾: conjoined. ﴿تَبارَكَ اللَّهُ﴾: an inflexible (jāmid) past verb, and the name of Majesty is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿رَبُّ﴾: adjective or badal (substitute). ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ; the two clauses are resumptive.

daas-irab:55-55.t:
﴿ادْعُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿رَبَّكُمْ﴾: its object. ﴿تَضَرُّعاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative.
﴿وَخُفْيَةً﴾: a conjoined noun. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause ﴿لا يُحِبُّ الْمُعْتَدِينَ﴾ is its khabar (predicate). The nominal clause ﴿إِنَّهُ لا يُحِبُّ﴾ is resumptive, and likewise the verbal clause ﴿ادْعُوا رَبَّكُمْ﴾.

daas-irab:56-56.t:
﴿وَلا تُفْسِدُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn because it is preceded by the prohibitive lā governing the jussive; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is conjoined.
﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them, and likewise the adverb ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ is attached to the verb. ﴿إِصْلاحِها﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وَادْعُوهُ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, with its agent and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿خَوْفاً وَطَمَعاً﴾: two ḥāls (circumstantials). ﴿إِنَّ رَحْمَتَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar (predicate), and the name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾: attached to قريب. The clause ﴿إِنَّ رَحْمَتَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ﴾ is explanatory (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:57-57.t: ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: a detached nominative pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥ, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the relative noun ﴿الَّذِي﴾ after it is its khabar (predicate), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿يُرْسِلُ الرِّياحَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object; its fāʿil (agent) is "he". ﴿بُشْراً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) يرسل. ﴿يَدَيْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the yāʾ because it is dual, the nūn having been dropped for annexation. ﴿رَحْمَتِهِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of commencement (ibtidāʾ). ﴿إِذا﴾: a conditional adverb. ﴿أَقَلَّتْ سَحاباً﴾: a past verb and its object; the tāʾ is the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine, and ﴿ثِقالًا﴾ is an adjective; the clause is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation). ﴿سُقْناهُ﴾: a past verb, its agent and its object; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive conditional. ﴿لِبَلَدٍ﴾: attached to سقناه. ﴿مَيِّتٍ﴾: adjective. ﴿فَأَنْزَلْنا بِهِ الْماءَ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; نا is its agent and الماء its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَأَخْرَجْنا بِهِ﴾: a past verb and its agent, and به is attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾: attached to an omitted mafʿūl bihi (direct object): "We brought forth kinds of every [fruit]" ﴿الثَّمَراتِ﴾. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object): ﴿نُخْرِجُ الْمَوْتى﴾ "a bringing forth like the bringing forth of fruit from dead trees ...". ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ﴾: لعل, the kāf is its noun, and the clause تذكرون is its khabar; the clause لعلكم تذكرون is explanatory (taʿlīliyya).

daas-irab:58-58.t:
﴿وَالْبَلَدُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الطَّيِّبُ﴾: adjective (ṣifa). ﴿يَخْرُجُ نَباتُهُ﴾: an imperfect verb and fāʿil (agent), and the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.
﴿بِإِذْنِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of an omitted mafʿūl bihi (direct object): "it comes forth good, by Allah's permission". ﴿رَبِّهِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The nominal clause والبلد ... is resumptive. ﴿وَالَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿لا يَخْرُجُ إِلَّا نَكِداً﴾ is its khabar; the clause ﴿خَبُثَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿نَكِداً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿كَذلِكَ نُصَرِّفُ الْآياتِ﴾: its i'rab has preceded; the clause ﴿يَشْكُرُونَ﴾ is in the position of the genitive as an adjective of قوم, and the preposition and its genitive noun لقوم are attached to نصرّف.

daas-irab:59-59.t: ﴿لَقَدْ﴾: the lām occurs in the response to an omitted oath; قد is a particle of realization. ﴿أَرْسَلْنا نُوحاً﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿إِلى قَوْمِهِ﴾ are attached; نا is its fāʿil (agent) and نوحا its object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَقالَ﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative with the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, which was dropped for lightness; the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation). ﴿اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its agent and the name of Majesty its object; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿ما﴾: negative, with no governing effect. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿إِلهٍ﴾: a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿غَيْرُهُ﴾: an adjective of إله following its position, nominative with the ḍamma; the clause is explanatory (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: inna, and the yāʾ is its noun. ﴿أَخافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذابَ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and عذاب is its object. ﴿يَوْمٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَظِيمٍ﴾: adjective. The clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna.

daas-irab:60-60.t: ﴿قالَ الْمَلَأُ﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ قَوْمِهِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الملأ, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّا﴾: inna, and نا is its noun. ﴿لَنَراكَ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); نراك is an imperfect verb, nominative with the ḍamma implied on the alif; its agent is latent (mustatir) and the kāf is its object. ﴿فِي ضَلالٍ﴾: attached to the verb before them. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾: adjective; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنا, and the clause إنا .. is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:61-61.t: ﴿قالَ يا قَوْمِ﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿لَيْسَ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; ﴿بِي﴾ is attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate), and ﴿ضَلالَةٌ﴾ is its noun; the clause is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَلكِنِّي﴾: a particle resembling the verb, and the yāʾ is its noun; ﴿رَسُولٌ﴾ is its khabar, and the following preposition and its genitive noun ﴿مِنْ رَبِّ﴾ are attached to it. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; the nominal clause is conjoined, and the clause قال is resumptive, like the one before it.

daas-irab:62-62.t: ﴿أُبَلِّغُكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb; the kāf is its first object, and the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural. ﴿رِسالاتِ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿رَبِّي﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the kasra implied on the letter before the first-person yāʾ; the yāʾ is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation), and the clause is in the position of the genitive as an adjective (ṣifa) of رسول. ﴿وَأَنْصَحُ لَكُمْ﴾: the verbal clause is conjoined, and likewise the clause ﴿وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ ... ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the clause ﴿لا تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ is its ṣila (relative clause).

daas-irab:63-63.t:
﴿أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; the tāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent), the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural, the wāw is a conjunction and the hamza is interrogative; the clause is conjoined to an implied clause: "did you deny and wonder ..". ﴿أَنْ﴾: a maṣdarī particle governing the accusative. ﴿جاءَكُمْ﴾: a past verb, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by a preposition: "or did you wonder at the coming of a man from among you?" ﴿ذِكْرٌ﴾: the agent of جاءكم. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb جاءكم.
﴿عَلى رَجُلٍ﴾: attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ذكر. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: attached to an omitted adjective of رجل. ﴿لِيُنْذِرَكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of purpose (taʿlīl), and the kāf is its object; the interpreted maṣdar formed from the implied an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb جاء. ﴿وَلِتَتَّقُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is its agent, and the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to the maṣdar before it: "for warning and for piety". ﴿وَلَعَلَّكُمْ﴾: a particle resembling the verb; the kāf is its noun and the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿تُرْحَمُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate), and the clause لعلكم ترحمون is explanatory (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:64-64.t: ﴿فَكَذَّبُوهُ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ its object; the clause is resumptive after the fāʾ. ﴿فَأَنْجَيْناهُ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn; نا is its agent and the hāʾ its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun conjoined to the accusative pronoun, the hāʾ. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿فِي الْفُلْكِ﴾: attached to the verb أنجينا. ﴿وَأَغْرَقْنَا الَّذِينَ﴾: a past verb, agent and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿كَذَّبُوا بِآياتِنا﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its agent; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾: inna; the hāʾ is its noun and the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿كانُوا قَوْماً﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar (predicate). ﴿عَمِينَ﴾: an adjective, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural [Translator's note: so in the source; as an adjective of قوما it would be accusative, which for this plural is likewise marked with the yāʾ]; the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna. The nominal clause إنهم ... is explanatory (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:65-65.t: ﴿وَإِلى عادٍ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "and We sent", and the implied clause is conjoined. ﴿أَخاهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the alif because it is one of the five nouns; the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation). ﴿هُوداً﴾: badal (substitute), accusative. ﴿قالَ يا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ﴾: its i'rab has preceded in verse 59; the clause قال is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَفَلا﴾: the hamza is interrogative, the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لا is negative with no governing effect; the clause ﴿تَتَّقُونَ﴾ is conjoined.

daas-irab:66-66.t:
﴿قالَ الْمَلَأُ﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the nominative as an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ قَوْمِهِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الملأ. ﴿إِنَّا لَنَراكَ فِي سَفاهَةٍ﴾: the i'rab of its like has preceded in verse 60. ﴿وَإِنَّا﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿لَنَظُنُّكَ مِنَ الْكاذِبِينَ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the kāf is its object.
The clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna, and [the lām is] the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

daas-irab:67-67.t: A similar i'rab has preceded in verse 61.

daas-irab:68-68.t: For its i'rab see verse 62. ﴿وَأَنَا﴾: a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) ﴿ناصِحٌ﴾. ﴿أَمِينٌ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) or a second khabar; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:156-156.t: ﴿وَاكْتُبْ لَنا﴾: a verb of supplication to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and its fāʿil (agent) is "أنت". ﴿فِي هذِهِ﴾: the demonstrative is in the position of the genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: badal (substitute). ﴿حَسَنَةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿إِنَّا﴾: inna, and نا is its noun. ﴿هُدْنا﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ are attached, and نا is its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of إنا, and the clause إنا هدنا إليك is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. The clause قال is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿عَذابِي﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أُصِيبُ بِهِ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the relative noun ﴿مَنْ﴾ is its mafʿūl, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar, and the clause ﴿أَشاءُ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَرَحْمَتِي﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ﴾: وسعت is a past verb with the tāʾ of the feminine, كل is its mafʿūl, and شيء is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the khabar. The clause ورحمتي... is conjoined. ﴿فَسَأَكْتُبُها لِلَّذِينَ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached; its fāʿil is "أنا", and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl; the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined; the clause ﴿يَتَّقُونَ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَيُؤْتُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and fāʿil. ﴿الزَّكاةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. The clause is conjoined. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُمْ﴾: a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause يؤمنون. ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb after them. The nominal clause ﴿هُمْ ... يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ الذين.

daas-irab:157-157.t:
﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, badal (substitute) from الذين in the previous verse. ﴿يَتَّبِعُونَ الرَّسُولَ﴾: an imperfect verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿النَّبِيَّ﴾: badal. ﴿الْأُمِّيَّ﴾: a second badal. And the relative noun ﴿الَّذِي﴾ is a third badal.
﴿يَجِدُونَهُ مَكْتُوباً﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its two objects. ﴿عِنْدَهُمْ﴾: an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) مكتوبا. ﴿فِي التَّوْراةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَالْإِنْجِيلِ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined).
﴿يَأْمُرُهُمْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ﴾: the verbal clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl. ﴿وَيَنْهاهُمْ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ﴾: the verbal clauses after it are conjoined to it. ﴿وَيَضَعُ عَنْهُمْ إِصْرَهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl; the fāʿil is "هو", and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb.
﴿وَالْأَغْلالَ﴾: conjoined. ﴿الَّتِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as a ṣifa (adjective) of الأغلال. ﴿كانَتْ﴾: a past and incomplete (nāqiṣ) verb, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿عَلَيْهِمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of كانت; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فَالَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to آمنوا. ﴿وَعَزَّرُوهُ وَنَصَرُوهُ وَاتَّبَعُوا﴾: the clauses are conjoined. ﴿النُّورَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as a ṣifa of النور. ﴿أُنْزِلَ مَعَهُ﴾: a past verb in the passive, to which the adverb معه is attached, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is omitted «[Translator's note: so in the source; it is usually taken as a latent pronoun.]»; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُمُ﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as a second mubtadaʾ, or a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position. ﴿الْمُفْلِحُونَ﴾: khabar of هم; the nominal clause هم المفلحون is in the position of the nominative as khabar of أولئك. And the clause أولئك هم المفلحون is the khabar of the relative noun فالذين.

daas-irab:158-158.t:
﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿يا أَيُّهَا﴾: أي is the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), in the position of the accusative governed by the vocative particle; and ها is a particle of alerting (tanbīh) with no grammatical position. ﴿النَّاسُ﴾: badal (substitute). ﴿إِنِّي رَسُولُ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar (predicate). ﴿اللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ﴾: the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِلَيْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial): "مبعوثا إليكم" (sent to you). ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾: ḥāl. The clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive as badal from الله, or in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿مُلْكُ﴾. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: conjoined; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿لا إِلهَ﴾: لا is the lā of generic negation, and إله is its noun; its khabar is omitted, its implied form being "موجود" (existing). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿هُوَ﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as badal from the latent pronoun in the omitted khabar. The clause is a badal from the ṣila clause before it. ﴿يُحيِي﴾: the clause is likewise a badal from the clause before it. ﴿وَيُمِيتُ﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَآمِنُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by the bāʾ, and both are attached to آمنوا. ﴿وَرَسُولِهِ﴾: conjoined; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿النَّبِيِّ﴾: a second badal. ﴿الْأُمِّيِّ﴾: a third badal. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, a fourth badal; and the clause ﴿يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَكَلِماتِهِ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by the bāʾ, and both are attached to يؤمن; and ﴿كَلِماتِهِ﴾ is conjoined. ﴿وَاتَّبِعُوهُ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its mafʿūl (object); the clause is conjoined to آمنوا. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾: لعل, and the kāf is its noun, and the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿تَهْتَدُونَ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as khabar of لعل.

daas-irab:159-159.t: ﴿وَمِنْ قَوْمِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مُوسى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أُمَّةٌ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) after the wāw. ﴿يَهْدُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "متلبسين بالحق" (clothed with the truth); the clause is in the position of the nominative as a ṣifa (adjective). ﴿وَبِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb ﴿يَعْدِلُونَ﴾ after them; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:160-160.t: ﴿وَقَطَّعْناهُمُ﴾: a past verb, fāʿil (agent) and first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اثْنَتَيْ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ because it is treated like the dual. ﴿عَشْرَةَ﴾: a component with no grammatical position. ﴿أَسْباطاً﴾: tamyīz (specification), accusative, or a badal (substitute). ﴿أُمَماً﴾: a badal, accusative, from أسباطا; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَأَوْحَيْنا﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿إِلى مُوسى﴾ are attached (mutaʿalliq), and نا is its fāʿil. ﴿إِذِ﴾: an adverb for past time, attached to أوحينا. ﴿اسْتَسْقاهُ قَوْمُهُ﴾: a past verb, its mafʿūl and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿أَنِ﴾: explicative (tafsīriyya). The clause ﴿اضْرِبْ بِعَصاكَ الْحَجَرَ﴾ has no grammatical position, being explicative. ﴿فَانْبَجَسَتْ مِنْهُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached. ﴿اثْنَتا﴾: fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the alif because it is treated like the dual. ﴿عَشْرَةَ﴾: a component with no grammatical position. ﴿عَيْناً﴾: tamyīz; the clause is conjoined. ﴿قَدْ عَلِمَ كُلُّ أُناسٍ مَشْرَبَهُمْ﴾: a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi, and ﴿أُناسٍ﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿وَظَلَّلْنا عَلَيْهِمُ الْغَمامَ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; نا is its fāʿil and الغمام its mafʿūl; the clause is conjoined, and likewise the clause ﴿وَأَنْزَلْنا عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَنَّ وَالسَّلْوى﴾. ﴿كُلُوا﴾: an imperative, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ طَيِّباتِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كلوا. ﴿ما رَزَقْناكُمْ﴾: ما is a relative, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; and a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; and the clause ﴿كُلُوا مِنْ طَيِّباتِ﴾ is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied verb of saying. ﴿وَما ظَلَمُونا﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl; ما is negating with no governing effect; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾: lightened, with no governing effect. ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna and its noun. ﴿أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾: a fronted mafʿūl bihi, and the clause ﴿يَظْلِمُونَ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as khabar (predicate); the clause ولكن كانوا is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

daas-irab:161-161.t:
﴿وَإِذْ﴾: an adverb for past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb "اذكر" (remember). ﴿قِيلَ لَهُمُ﴾: a past verb in the passive, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿اسْكُنُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿هذِهِ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْقَرْيَةَ﴾: badal (substitute); the clause is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَكُلُوا مِنْها﴾: the clause is conjoined.
﴿حَيْثُ﴾: an adverb of place, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative; the clause is conjoined. ﴿شِئْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿وَقُولُوا﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿حِطَّةٌ﴾: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "شأننا" (our affair); the nominal clause is the speech reported. ﴿وَادْخُلُوا الْبابَ﴾: an imperative, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl. ﴿سُجَّداً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿نَغْفِرْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the command (jawāb al-ṭalab). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿خَطِيئاتِكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; the clause has no grammatical position, being the answer to the command. ﴿سَنَزِيدُ﴾: an imperfect verb. ﴿الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya).

daas-irab:162-162.t:
﴿فَبَدَّلَ الَّذِينَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb; the relative noun is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿قَوْلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿غَيْرَ﴾: ṣifa (adjective). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿قِيلَ﴾: a past verb in the passive, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) it. ﴿فَأَرْسَلْنا عَلَيْهِمْ رِجْزاً مِنَ السَّماءِ بِما كانُوا يَظْلِمُونَ﴾. ﴿بِما﴾: ما is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), and the first maṣdar «[Translator's note: so in the source, "المصدر الأول"; probably "المصدر المؤول", the interpreted maṣdar, is meant.]» is in the position of the genitive governed by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أرسلنا. The i'rab of this verse has preceded in Surat al-Baqara, number 59, with a difference hardly worth mentioning.

daas-irab:163-163.t:
﴿وَسْئَلْهُمْ عَنِ الْقَرْيَةِ﴾: an imperative verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the hāʾ is its mafʿūl (object) and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).
﴿الَّتِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive as a ṣifa (adjective). ﴿كانَتْ حاضِرَةَ﴾: kāna, its noun a latent pronoun, and حاضرة its khabar (predicate).
﴿الْبَحْرِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb for past time, attached to حاضرة. ﴿يَعْدُونَ فِي السَّبْتِ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb attached to يعدون, or a badal (substitute) from the first إذ. ﴿تَأْتِيهِمْ حِيتانُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, its mafʿūl and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to the verb. ﴿سَبْتِهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿شُرَّعاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾: conjoined.
And the clause ﴿لا يَسْبِتُونَ﴾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation, and the clause ﴿لا تَأْتِيهِمْ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the implied form: ﴿نَبْلُوهُمْ﴾ "بلاء كائنا كذلك البلاء" (We test them with a testing like that testing). ﴿نَبْلُوهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl. ﴿بِما﴾: maṣdariyya; the interpreted maṣdar formed from it and the verb after it is in the position of the genitive governed by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb نبلوهم. ﴿كانُوا﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), and the clause ﴿يَفْسُقُونَ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as khabar of كانوا.

daas-irab:164-164.t: ﴿وَإِذْ﴾: conjoined to the first إذ in the previous verse. ﴿قالَتْ أُمَّةٌ﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of أمة; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿لِمَ﴾: ما is an interrogative noun in the position of the genitive governed by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تعظون. And the verbal clause لم ﴿تَعِظُونَ﴾: the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قَوْماً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهُ مُهْلِكُهُمْ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject) and مهلكهم is khabar (predicate), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the speech reported. ﴿أَوْ مُعَذِّبُهُمْ﴾: conjoined. ﴿عَذاباً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿شَدِيداً﴾: ṣifa. ﴿قالُوا﴾: the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿مَعْذِرَةً﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "we admonished them for the sake of excuse", or mafʿūl muṭlaq: "لنعتذر معذرة" (that we may excuse ourselves with an excuse). And with the nominative reading, it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "موعظتنا معذرة" (our admonition is an excuse). ﴿إِلى رَبِّكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to معذرة. The implied clause is the speech reported. ﴿وَلَعَلَّهُمْ﴾: لعل and its noun, and the clause ﴿يَتَّقُونَ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as khabar; the clause (ولعلهم) is conjoined.

daas-irab:165-165.t:
﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: لما is adverbial (ẓarfiyya) and conditional, and the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿نَسُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the relative noun ﴿ما﴾ is its mafʿūl (object).
﴿ذُكِّرُوا بِهِ﴾: a past verb in the passive, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿أَنْجَيْنَا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: the relative noun is its mafʿūl. ﴿يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ السُّوءِ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the clause أنجينا has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. The verbal clause ﴿وَأَخَذْنَا الَّذِينَ﴾ is conjoined, and the clause ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿بِعَذابٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ظلموا. «[Translator's note: so in the source; بعذاب is attached to أخذنا.]» ﴿بَئِيسٍ﴾: ṣifa (adjective). ﴿بِما كانُوا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar formed from ما and the verb after it is in the position of the genitive governed by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb أخذنا, i.e. "We seized those who did wrong because of their transgression". ﴿يَفْسُقُونَ﴾: the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا.

daas-irab:166-166.t:
﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: adverbial (ẓarfiyya) and conditional. ﴿عَتَوْا﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (in the genitive by annexation). ﴿عَنْ ما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿نُهُوا﴾: a past verb in the passive and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿عَنْهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿قُلْنا لَهُمْ﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿كُونُوا قِرَدَةً﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar (predicate).
﴿خاسِئِينَ﴾: ṣifa (adjective); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:167-167.t:
