﴿وَإِذْ﴾: an adverb of time, accusative, governed by an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر وقت" (remember the time); the implied clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿لَيَبْعَثَنَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the lām occurs in the answer to an oath understood from His saying تأذن. The clause has no grammatical position, being the answer to the oath. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿إِلى يَوْمِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb يبعثن. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿يَسُومُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is its first object. ﴿سُوءَ﴾: its second object. ﴿الْعَذابِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَسَرِيعُ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar (predicate), and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). The clause is causal (taʿlīliyya). ﴿الْعِقابِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَإِنَّهُ لَغَفُورٌ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar, and the shifted lām. ﴿رَحِيمٌ﴾: a second khabar.

daas-irab:168-168.t:
﴿وَقَطَّعْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb, fāʿil (agent) and first object. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿أُمَماً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿مِنْهُمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿الصَّالِحُونَ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿دُونَ﴾: the adverb is attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "منهم أناس هابطون دون ذلك" (among them are people falling short of that). ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: the demonstrative is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
The clause منهم الصالحون is in the position of the accusative as a ṣifa of أمما, and the clause ومنهم دون ذلك is conjoined. ﴿وَبَلَوْناهُمْ بِالْحَسَناتِ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; نا is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its mafʿūl. ﴿وَالسَّيِّئاتِ﴾: conjoined; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ﴾: لعل and its noun, and the clause يرجعون is the khabar; the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīliyya).

daas-irab:69-69.t: ﴿أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ﴾: for its i'rab see verse 63. ﴿وَاذْكُرُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِذْ﴾: meaning "time", indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause is conjoined by the wāw to an implied clause, i.e., "do not wonder, and remember ...". ﴿جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفاءَ﴾: a past verb; the kāf is its first object and ﴿خُلَفاءَ﴾ its second object. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of خلفاء. ﴿قَوْمِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿نُوحٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation). ﴿زادَكُمْ فِي الْخَلْقِ بَصْطَةً﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the kāf is its first object and بصطة its second object, or it is a tamyīz (specification); the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَاذْكُرُوا آلاءَ اللَّهِ﴾: a past verb [Translator's note: so in the source; اذكروا is an imperative verb], its agent and its object; الله, the name of Majesty, is muḍāf ilayhi; the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa, i.e., "if you know that, then remember the favours of Allah", and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition. The clause ﴿تُفْلِحُونَ﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of لعل, and the clause ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ﴾ is explanatory (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:70-70.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَجِئْتَنا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; the tāʾ is its agent and نا its object; the hamza is interrogative, and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لِنَعْبُدَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of purpose (taʿlīl); the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَحْدَهُ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation). ﴿وَنَذَرَ﴾: conjoined to نعبد. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كانَ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿يَعْبُدُ آباؤُنا﴾: an imperfect verb and its agent; there is a contention (tanāzuʿ) here between kāna, which requires a noun, and يعبد, which requires an agent. The clause كان is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿يَعْبُدُ آباؤُنا﴾ is in the position of the accusative as khabar (predicate). ﴿فَأْتِنا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter from its end, since it is weak-final; its agent is "you" and نا is its object; the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa: "if what you say is true, then bring us what you promise us ...". ﴿بِما﴾: [ما is] a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿تَعِدُنا﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a jussive conditional particle. ﴿كُنْتَ﴾: a defective past verb; the tāʾ is its noun, and the verb is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ﴾: a genitive noun, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of the defective verb; the clause كنت is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:71-71.t:
﴿قالَ قَدْ وَقَعَ﴾: the i'rab of its like has preceded. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb وقع. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from رجس; it was an adjective (ṣifa) of it, and when it was placed before it, it became a ḥāl. ﴿رِجْسٌ﴾: fāʿil (agent). ﴿وَغَضَبٌ﴾: conjoined. ﴿أَتُجادِلُونَنِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its agent and the yāʾ its object; the first nūn is for protection (wiqāya) and the hamza is interrogative.
﴿فِي أَسْماءٍ﴾: attached to the verb before them; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause قد وقع عليكم is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl) ... ﴿سَمَّيْتُمُوها﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is attached to the vowelled tāʾ of the agent; the tāʾ is in the position of the nominative as agent, the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural, and its ḍamma has been lengthened into a wāw. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾: a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as tawkīd (emphasis) of the tāʾ of the agent in سميتموها. ﴿وَآباؤُكُمْ﴾: a conjoined noun. ﴿ما نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ بِها﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the name of Majesty is its agent. ﴿مِنْ سُلْطانٍ﴾: its object, and من is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; the clause is in the position of the genitive as an adjective of أسماء, and likewise the clause سميتموها before it. ﴿فَانْتَظِرُوا﴾: the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa; انتظروا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied non-jussive condition: "if you associate partners, then wait". ﴿إِنِّي﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿مَعَكُمْ﴾: an adverb of place attached to المنتظرين after it, and the kāf is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation). ﴿مِنَ الْمُنْتَظِرِينَ﴾: a genitive noun, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of إني, and the clause is explanatory (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:72-72.t: ﴿فَأَنْجَيْناهُ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; نا is its fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ its object; the clause is resumptive after the fāʾ. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun conjoined to the accusative pronoun. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, the implied sense being "and those who believed with him"; the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation). ﴿بِرَحْمَةٍ﴾: attached to the verb أنجينا. ﴿مِنَّا﴾: attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of رحمة. ﴿وَقَطَعْنا﴾: a past verb and its agent. ﴿دابِرَ﴾: its object, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿كَذَّبُوا﴾: a past verb to which the following preposition and its genitive noun ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾ are attached; the wāw is its agent, and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun ... ﴿وَما كانُوا مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar (predicate); ما is negative, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:73-73.t:
﴿وَإِلى ثَمُودَ أَخاهُمْ صالِحاً﴾: this is like the saying of Allah the Exalted in verse 64 [Translator's note: so in the source; the words quoted are in verse 65], ﴿وَإِلى عادٍ أَخاهُمْ هُوداً﴾, which preceded in the surah. ﴿قَدْ جاءَتْكُمْ﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine, the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm is for the plural. ﴿بَيِّنَةٌ﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative.
﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of بينة. ﴿هذِهِ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿ناقَةُ﴾: khabar (predicate). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of آية, because it is placed before it.
﴿آيَةً﴾: ḥāl from ناقة, accusative. The nominal clause ﴿هذِهِ ناقَةُ اللَّهِ﴾ is resumptive, or explicative of بينة before it.
﴿فَذَرُوها﴾: the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa; ذروها is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its agent and the hāʾ its object; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied non-jussive condition: "if that is established, then leave her". ﴿تَأْكُلْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the response to the imperative; the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿فِي أَرْضِ﴾ are attached to it, and its agent is latent (mustatir). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition not joined to the fāʾ or to the إذا of surprise. ﴿وَلا تَمَسُّوها﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn because it is preceded by the prohibitive lā governing the jussive; the wāw is its agent and the hāʾ its object. ﴿بِسُوءٍ﴾: attached to the verb before them, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the fāʾ of causation, and the kāf is its object. The interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb is conjoined to an implied maṣdar before it. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾: agent. ﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾: adjective.

daas-irab:74-74.t: ﴿وَاذْكُرُوا إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ﴾: its i'rab has preceded in verse 69. ﴿وَبَوَّأَكُمْ﴾: a past verb to which the following preposition and its genitive noun ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ are attached. The kāf is its object and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is conjoined to the clause جعلكم. ﴿تَتَّخِذُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its agent. ﴿مِنْ سُهُولِها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from قصورا; it was an adjective (ṣifa), and when it was placed first it became a ḥāl. ﴿قُصُوراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl. ﴿وَتَنْحِتُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its agent. ﴿الْجِبالَ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بُيُوتاً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. Or الجبال is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e., "from the mountains" ...; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَاذْكُرُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its agent, and the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa. ﴿آلاءَ﴾: its object. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition: "if that is true ...". ﴿وَلا تَعْثَوْا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the agent. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl from مفسدين after them. ﴿مُفْسِدِينَ﴾: ḥāl, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:75-75.t:
﴿قالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا﴾: for its i'rab see verse 66. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾: the lām is a preposition; الذين is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn [Translator's note: so in the source; الذين is elsewhere described as indeclinable on the fatḥ], in the position of the genitive by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb قال. ﴿اسْتُضْعِفُوا﴾: a passive past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾: the lām is a preposition; من is a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are a badal (substitute) of للذين before them. ﴿آمَنَ﴾: a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he", referring to من. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: attached to the verb آمن, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَتَعْلَمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its agent; the hamza is interrogative, and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَنَّ صالِحاً مُرْسَلٌ﴾: anna, its noun and its khabar (predicate); they are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) standing in place of the two objects of علم. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِ﴾: attached to the passive participle مرسل. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a resumptive clause. ﴿إِنَّا﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿بِما﴾: attached to the verb [Translator's note: so in the source; it is presumably attached to مؤمنون].
﴿أُرْسِلَ﴾: a passive past verb, and its deputy agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he". ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to أرسل, and the clause is the ṣila. The nominal clause إنا ... مؤمنون is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) after the verb of saying. ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to the khabar. ﴿مُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: khabar.

daas-irab:76-76.t: ﴿قالَ الَّذِينَ﴾: a past verb, and the relative noun after it is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿اسْتَكْبَرُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّا﴾: inna, and the assimilated نا is its noun. ﴿بِالَّذِي﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). ﴿آمَنْتُمْ﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as agent, and the mīm is for the masculine plural; the clause is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to the verb. ﴿كافِرُونَ﴾: khabar; the nominal clause إنا بالذي آمنتم به كافرون is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) after the verb of saying.

daas-irab:77-77.t: ﴿فَعَقَرُوا النَّاقَةَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَعَتَوْا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied on the dropped alif, and the wāw is the agent. ﴿عَنْ أَمْرِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿يا صالِحُ﴾: يا is a vocative particle; صالح is the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper noun, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative. ﴿ائْتِنا بِما تَعِدُنا..﴾: its i'rab has preceded in verse 70.

daas-irab:78-78.t:
﴿فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥ; the tāʾ is for the feminine, the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm is for the masculine plural.
﴿الرَّجْفَةُ﴾: fāʿil (agent), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَأَصْبَحُوا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿فِي دارِهِمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) ﴿جاثِمِينَ﴾, which is accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:79-79.t: ﴿فَتَوَلَّى﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied on the alif, to which the following preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), accusative with the fatḥa implied on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, which was dropped for lightness. ﴿لَقَدْ﴾: the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath — "by Allah, I have conveyed to you" — and قد is a particle of realization. ﴿أَبْلَغْتُكُمْ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn; the tāʾ is its fāʿil (agent), the kāf its first object, and ﴿رِسالَةَ﴾ its second object. ﴿رَبِّي﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the kasra implied on the letter before the first-person yāʾ; the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the response to the implied oath. The clause يا قوم لقد أبلغتكم ... is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). The clause ﴿نَصَحْتُ﴾ لكم is conjoined. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾: a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿لا تُحِبُّونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its agent, and لا is negative with no governing effect. ﴿النَّاصِحِينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the yāʾ; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:80-80.t: ﴿وَلُوطاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember". ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb for past time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb to which the following preposition and its genitive noun ﴿لِقَوْمِهِ﴾ are attached; the clause is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation), and the clause "remember Lūṭ" is conjoined. ﴿أَتَأْتُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the hamza is interrogative. ﴿الْفاحِشَةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿ما سَبَقَكُمْ﴾: a past verb; the kāf is its object and the mīm the sign of the masculine plural; ما is negative with no governing effect. ﴿بِها﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿مِنْ أَحَدٍ﴾: من is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; أحد is a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as agent. ﴿مِنَ الْعالَمِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of أحد. The verbal clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) from الفاحشة.

daas-irab:81-81.t:
﴿إِنَّكُمْ﴾: inna; the kāf is its noun and the mīm is for the plural. ﴿لَتَأْتُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿الرِّجالَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿شَهْوَةً﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative, or ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl from الرجال. ﴿النِّساءِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بَلْ﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb).
﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾: a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿قَوْمٌ﴾: khabar. ﴿مُسْرِفُونَ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa), nominative with the wāw, and the nūn is in compensation for the tanwīn in the singular noun. The nominal clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:82-82.t:
﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is negative. ﴿كانَ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿جَوابَ﴾: its fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿قَوْمِهِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ﴾: a maṣdarī particle governing the accusative. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); it is in the position of the accusative by an; the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb after it is in the position of the nominative as the noun of kāna.
﴿أَخْرِجُوهُمْ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its agent, the hāʾ its object, and the mīm the sign of the masculine plural.
﴿مِنْ قَرْيَتِكُمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them, and the clause is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾: inna, and the hāʾ is its noun. ﴿أُناسٌ﴾: its khabar.
The clause is explanatory (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿يَتَطَهَّرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its agent, and the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna [Translator's note: so in the source; يتطهرون is more naturally an adjective of أناس].

daas-irab:83-83.t: ﴿فَأَنْجَيْناهُ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, with its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَأَهْلَهُ﴾: a noun conjoined to the accusative pronoun, and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿امْرَأَتَهُ﴾: the excepted (mustathnā), accusative, and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿كانَتْ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "she". ﴿مِنَ الْغابِرِينَ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). The clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) from امرأته.

daas-irab:84-84.t: ﴿وَأَمْطَرْنا عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ are attached; نا is its fāʿil (agent) and ﴿مَطَراً﴾ its object; and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition: "if that has taken place" ﴿فَانْظُرْ﴾ ... [Translator's note: so in the source; the apodosis remark evidently belongs to the clause فانظر, whose fāʾ is the faṣīḥa]. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿كانَ عاقِبَةُ﴾: kāna and its noun. ﴿الْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb انظر ...

daas-irab:169-169.t:
﴿فَخَلَفَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and خلف is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to the clause (وقطعناهم), and the verbal clause ﴿وَرِثُوا الْكِتابَ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as a ṣifa (adjective) of خلف. ﴿يَأْخُذُونَ عَرَضَ﴾: an imperfect verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is a second ṣifa. ﴿هذَا﴾: a demonstrative in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿الْأَدْنى﴾: badal (substitute), genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the implied (muqaddar) kasra.
﴿وَيَقُولُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿سَيُغْفَرُ لَنا﴾: an imperfect verb in the passive, to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿لَنا﴾ are attached; its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) refers back to what precedes it, i.e. "the taking will be forgiven us". The clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and إن is conditional. ﴿يَأْتِهِمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by إن, the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the weak letter from its end; the hāʾ is its mafʿūl, and ﴿عَرَضَ﴾ is its fāʿil. ﴿مِثْلُهُ﴾: ṣifa; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿يَأْخُذُوهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its mafʿūl; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined to the fāʾ.
﴿أَلَمْ يُؤْخَذْ عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and an imperfect verb in the passive, jussive, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; ﴿مِيثاقُ﴾ is its nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِنْ﴾: a maṣdar-forming particle governing the subjunctive. «[Translator's note: so in the source, "إن"; the particle in the verse is أَنْ.]» ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿يَقُولُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the deletion of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by على; both are attached to the verb. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الْحَقَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is in the position of the genitive governed by a preposition, the implied form being: "بعدم قولهم إلا الحق" (that they should not say anything but the truth). ﴿وَدَرَسُوا ما فِيهِ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the relative noun ما is its mafʿūl; and ﴿فِيهِ﴾ is attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause), i.e. "ما كتب فيه" (what is written in it); the clause درسوا is conjoined to the clause يؤخذ because it has the meaning of أخذ. ﴿وَالدَّارُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْآخِرَةُ﴾: ṣifa. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾: its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is resumptive.
﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خير before them. The clause ﴿يَتَّقُونَ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَفَلا تَعْقِلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to an implied clause, and the hamza is for interrogation.

daas-irab:170-170.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُمَسِّكُونَ بِالْكِتابِ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the verbal clause ﴿وَأَقامُوا الصَّلاةَ﴾ is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّا﴾: inna, and نا is its noun; its original form is إننا, its nūn having been deleted for lightness. ﴿لا نُضِيعُ﴾: لا is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿أَجْرَ﴾: its mafʿūl (object). ﴿الْمُصْلِحِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of إنا. And the nominal clause ﴿إِنَّا لا نُضِيعُ﴾.. is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ الذين.

daas-irab:171-171.t: ﴿وَإِذْ﴾: an adverb of time (ẓarfiyya ḥīniyya), attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied verb "اذكر" (remember). The wāw is a conjunction, and the implied clause is conjoined to the clause وإذ تأذن ربك.. ﴿نَتَقْنَا الْجَبَلَ﴾: a past verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَوْقَهُمْ﴾: an adverb of place attached to the verb. ﴿كَأَنَّهُ ظُلَّةٌ﴾: كأن, its noun and its khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَظَنُّوا﴾: a past verb and fāʿil, and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿أَنَّهُ واقِعٌ﴾: anna, its noun and its khabar. ﴿بِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to واقع. أن with what follows it stands in place of the two objects of ظنّ. ﴿خُذُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿ما آتَيْناكُمْ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn; نا is its fāʿil and the kāf its mafʿūl; the relative noun before it is the object of خذوا, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿بِقُوَّةٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خذوا. ﴿وَاذْكُرُوا﴾: an imperative and its fāʿil. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِيهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ﴾: لعل and its noun, and the clause تتقون is the khabar; the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:172-172.t:
﴿وَإِذْ﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿أَخَذَ رَبُّكَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (in the genitive by annexation). ﴿مِنْ﴾: a preposition. ﴿بَنِي﴾: a genitive (majrūr) noun, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; the nūn has been deleted for annexation. ﴿آدَمَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive by the fatḥa because of being a proper noun and foreign. ﴿مِنْ ظُهُورِهِمْ﴾: badal (substitute) from the preposition and its genitive noun before them. ﴿ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb أخذ; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿وَأَشْهَدَهُمْ﴾: a past verb, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl. ﴿عَلى أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَلَسْتُ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ being its noun, and the hamza is for interrogation. ﴿بِرَبِّكُمْ﴾: a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, the khabar (predicate) of لست; the kāf is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the mīm is for the masculine plural, and the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. The clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb of saying. ﴿قالُوا﴾: the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿بَلى﴾: a particle of answer.
﴿شَهِدْنا﴾: a past verb and fāʿil; the clause is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَنْ تَقُولُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive governed by a preposition, the implied form being "لئلا تقولوا" (lest you say); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb شهدنا. It is also said that the implied form is "شهدنا كراهية قولكم" (we testified out of dislike of your saying). ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: attached to تقولوا. ﴿إِنَّا﴾: inna and its noun.
﴿كُنَّا﴾: kāna and its noun. ﴿عَنْ هذا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar ﴿غافِلِينَ﴾; the clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar of إنا, and the clause إنا كنا.. is the speech reported.

daas-irab:173-173.t:
﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿تَقُولُوا﴾: conjoined to أن تقولوا, the implied form being "لئلا تقولوا" (lest you say). ﴿إِنَّما﴾: the restraining particle and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿أَشْرَكَ آباؤُنا﴾: a past verb and a nominative fāʿil (agent), and نا is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾: قبل is an adverb of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the genitive governed by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أشرك, and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَكُنَّا ذُرِّيَّةً﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ﴾:
a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of ذرية; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَفَتُهْلِكُنا﴾: an imperfect verb and mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hamza is for interrogation. ﴿بِما﴾: ما is a relative noun in the position of the genitive governed by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb, and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). The verbal clause ﴿فَعَلَ الْمُبْطِلُونَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause).

daas-irab:174-174.t: ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of the genitive governed by the kāf; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the implied form being "نفصل الآيات تفصيلا كائنا كذلك التفصيل" (We set out the signs in detail with a detailing like that detailing). ﴿نُفَصِّلُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is "نحن". ﴿الْآياتِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ﴾: the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), and the clause يرجعون is the khabar (predicate) of لعل.

daas-irab:175-175.t:
﴿وَاتْلُ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the weak letter, and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿نَبَأَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to the implied clause (واذكر إذ أخذ..). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿آتَيْناهُ﴾: a past verb, fāʿil and first object.
﴿آياتِنا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿فَانْسَلَخَ مِنْها﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; its fāʿil is latent, and the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿فَأَتْبَعَهُ الشَّيْطانُ﴾: a past verb, its mafʿūl and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَكانَ مِنَ الْغاوِينَ﴾: kāna, its noun a latent pronoun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:176-176.t: ﴿وَلَوْ﴾: لو is a non-jussive conditional. ﴿شِئْنا﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿لَرَفَعْناهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl (object); the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿بِها﴾ ﴿وَلكِنَّهُ﴾: lākinna, and the hāʾ is its noun, and the verbal clause ﴿أَخْلَدَ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause ولكنه is conjoined, and likewise the clause ﴿وَاتَّبَعَ هَواهُ﴾ is conjoined. ﴿فَمَثَلُهُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿كَمَثَلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْكَلْبِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a jussive particle that puts two imperfect verbs in the jussive. ﴿تَحْمِلْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and its fāʿil is "أنت"; the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يَلْهَثْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive as the apodosis, and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition «[Translator's note: so in the source, "غير جازم"; إن here is a jussive conditional.]» not joined to the fāʾ or to the إذا of surprise. ﴿أَوْ تَتْرُكْهُ يَلْهَثْ﴾: conjoined. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf is a particle of address. ﴿مَثَلُ﴾: its khabar. ﴿الْقَوْمِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive as a ṣifa (adjective); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿كَذَّبُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كذبوا; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿فَاقْصُصِ﴾: an imperative verb, and its fāʿil is a latent pronoun; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition). ﴿الْقَصَصَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied non-jussive condition: "إذا عرفت ذلك فاقصص القصص" (if you know that, then relate the stories). And the clause ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position, and the clause يتفكرون is the khabar of لعل.

daas-irab:177-177.t: ﴿ساءَ﴾: a past verb for expressing blame, and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun explained by the tamyīz (specification) after it, i.e. "evil is the example of the people who denied". The clause is a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَثَلًا﴾: tamyīz, accusative. ﴿الْقَوْمُ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the nominative as a ṣifa (adjective). ﴿كَذَّبُوا بِآياتِنا﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَأَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾: a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), and the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural. ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna and its noun; the clause is conjoined, and the clause ﴿يَظْلِمُونَ﴾ is its khabar.

daas-irab:178-178.t: ﴿مَنْ﴾: a jussive conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَهْدِ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the yāʾ because it has a weak final letter; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its object is omitted, i.e. يهده; and ﴿اللَّهُ﴾, the Name of Majesty, is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿فَهُوَ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and هو is a nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْمُهْتَدِي﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ because of heaviness; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The two clauses of the condition and the apodosis are the khabar of من. ﴿وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ﴾: conjoined to what preceded, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُمُ﴾: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, or a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْخاسِرُونَ﴾: its khabar; the clause هم الخاسرون is the khabar of أولئك, and the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis; and the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis are the khabar of من.

daas-irab:179-179.t:
﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to an oath, قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq), and the wāw is resumptive. ﴿ذَرَأْنا﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent).
﴿لِجَهَنَّمَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿كَثِيراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنَ الْجِنِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of كثيرا. ﴿وَالْإِنْسِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿قُلُوبٌ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as a ṣifa of كثيرا. ﴿لا يَفْقَهُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and لا is negating with no governing effect. ﴿بِها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is in the position of the nominative as a ṣifa of قلوب.
﴿وَلَهُمْ أَعْيُنٌ لا يُبْصِرُونَ بِها، وَلَهُمْ آذانٌ لا يَسْمَعُونَ بِها﴾: their i'rab is like the i'rab of the previous verse. «[Translator's note: so in the source; the reference is to the preceding phrase of this same verse.]» ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿كَالْأَنْعامِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك; the nominal clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿بَلْ﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿هُمْ أَضَلُّ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar. The clause is conjoined. ﴿أُولئِكَ هُمُ الْغافِلُونَ﴾: its i'rab is like the i'rab of ﴿فَأُولئِكَ هُمُ الْخاسِرُونَ﴾.

daas-irab:180-180.t:
﴿وَلِلَّهِ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the Name of Majesty is genitive (majrūr) by the lām; both are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) ﴿الْأَسْماءُ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْحُسْنى﴾: a ṣifa (adjective), nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif, its appearance prevented by impossibility. The nominal clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿فَادْعُوهُ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ its mafʿūl (object); the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿بِها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَذَرُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: the relative noun is its mafʿūl; the clause is conjoined.
﴿يُلْحِدُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فِي أَسْمائِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿سَيُجْزَوْنَ ما كانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, in the passive; the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) and the relative noun ما is its mafʿūl; the clause is resumptive, and the clause كانوا is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the clause يعملون is in the position of the accusative as khabar.

daas-irab:181-181.t: ﴿وَمِمَّنْ﴾: من is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive governed by من; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿خَلَقْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿أُمَّةٌ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), and the verbal clause ﴿خَلَقْنا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿يَهْدُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is in the position of the nominative as a ṣifa (adjective). ﴿وَبِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb ﴿يَعْدِلُونَ﴾ after them; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:182-182.t:
﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the verbal clause ﴿كَذَّبُوا بِآياتِنا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُمْ﴾: the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb; the hāʾ is its mafʿūl (object), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "نحن". ﴿مِنْ﴾: a preposition. ﴿حَيْثُ﴾: an adverb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the genitive governed by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate).
And the clause ﴿لا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).

daas-irab:183-183.t: ﴿وَأُمْلِي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or resumptive, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ because of heaviness, and its fāʿil (agent) is "أنا". ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ ﴿وَأُمْلِي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or resumptive, and an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ because of heaviness, and its fāʿil is "أنا". «[Translator's note: the source repeats this passage verbatim.]» ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. The clause is conjoined or resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ كَيْدِي﴾: inna is a particle resembling the verb; كيدي is the noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿مَتِينٌ﴾: khabar (predicate). The nominal clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:85-85.t:
﴿وَإِلى مَدْيَنَ﴾: مدين is a genitive noun, [genitive] with the fatḥa in place of the kasra, being a non-Arab proper noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb أرسلنا. ﴿أَخاهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the alif because it is one of the five nouns; the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation), and the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural. ﴿شُعَيْباً﴾: badal (substitute), accusative, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿قالَ يا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ﴾: its counterpart has preceded in verse 59. ﴿قَدْ جاءَتْكُمْ بَيِّنَةٌ﴾: a past verb, its object and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾: attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of بينة. ﴿فَأَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ﴾: an imperative verb, its agent and its object; the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَلا تَبْخَسُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lā; the wāw is the agent, ﴿النَّاسَ﴾ the first mafʿūl bihi, and ﴿أَشْياءَهُمْ﴾ the second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلا تُفْسِدُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: the prohibitive lā and a jussive imperfect verb. ﴿بَعْدَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to تفسدوا. ﴿إِصْلاحِها﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ذلِكُمْ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾: khabar (predicate), and ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ is attached to خير; the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a jussive conditional particle. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun. ﴿مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: its khabar, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.
The clause is resumptive, and the apodosis of the condition is omitted, what precedes indicating it.

daas-irab:86-86.t:
﴿وَلا تَقْعُدُوا﴾: the prohibitive lā and a jussive (majzūm) imperfect verb to which the following preposition and its genitive noun ﴿بِكُلِّ﴾ are attached. ﴿صِراطٍ﴾: muḍāf [Translator's note: so in the source; صراط is the muḍāf ilayhi of كل].
﴿تُوعِدُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause ﴿وَتَصُدُّونَ﴾ is conjoined to it. ﴿عَنْ سَبِيلِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the verbal clause ﴿آمَنَ بِهِ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَتَبْغُونَها﴾: an imperfect verb and its agent, accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the verbal clause ﴿آمَنَ بِهِ﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position [Translator's note: this passage is a garbled repetition in the source, reproduced as written]. ﴿وَتَبْغُونَها﴾: an imperfect verb, its agent and its object. ﴿عِوَجاً﴾: ḥāl; the clause is conjoined, so it too is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl. ﴿وَاذْكُرُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its agent, and the clause is conjoined to the clause لا تقعدوا. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb for past time, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative. ﴿كُنْتُمْ قَلِيلًا﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation). ﴿فَكَثَّرَكُمْ﴾: a past verb, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَانْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كانَ عاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِينَ﴾: its i'rab has preceded in verse 84.

daas-irab:87-87.t:
﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إن is a jussive conditional particle that makes two imperfect verbs jussive. ﴿كانَ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the overt fatḥa, and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿طائِفَةٌ﴾: its noun. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of طائفة. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿بِالَّذِي﴾ are attached; the clause is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of kāna.
﴿أُرْسِلْتُ﴾: a passive past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn; the tāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to أرسلت. ﴿وَطائِفَةٌ﴾: a noun conjoined to the first طائفة.
﴿لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the clause is in the position of the nominative as an adjective of طائفة. ﴿فَاصْبِرُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the agent, the fāʾ links the apodosis, and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and of the genitive. ﴿يَحْكُمَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after حتى; the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb اصبروا. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the name of Majesty, agent. ﴿بَيْنَنا﴾: an adverb attached to the verb before it. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the wāw is circumstantial. ﴿خَيْرُ﴾: khabar. ﴿الْحاكِمِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. The nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). And Allah knows best.

daas-irab:88-88.t:
﴿قالَ الْمَلَأُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the nominative as an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿اسْتَكْبَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its agent. ﴿مِنْ قَوْمِهِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of استكبروا, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿لَنُخْرِجَنَّكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥ because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath; the clause has no grammatical position, being the response to the oath. ﴿يا شُعَيْبُ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper noun, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on the fatḥ, conjoined to the kāf in لنخرجنك. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, to which the adverb ﴿مَعَكَ﴾ after it is attached; the wāw is its agent. ﴿مِنْ قَرْيَتِنا﴾: attached to the verb before them, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿لَتَعُودُنَّ﴾: the lām occurs in the response to the oath; تعودن is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; its origin is تعودون, then the heavy nūn of emphasis was attached to it so that it became تعودونن, then the first nūn was dropped through dislike of a succession of nūns so that it became تعودون [Translator's note: so in the source; i.e., تعودونّ], then the quiescent wāw was dropped to prevent the meeting of two quiescent letters, and the ḍamma remained as an indication of it; the wāw is the agent if the meaning of تعودن is "you will return". It is also possible to parse تعودون as a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb meaning "you will become", the wāw being its noun and the preposition and its genitive noun after it being attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined to the clause لنخرجنك يا شعيب. ﴿فِي مِلَّتِنا﴾: attached to the verb before them. ﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَوَلَوْ﴾: the hamza is an interrogative particle, and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لَوْ﴾: a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿كُنَّا كارِهِينَ﴾: kāna and its noun, and ﴿كارِهِينَ﴾ is its khabar, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is a mafʿūl bihi, and the apodosis (jawāb) of law is omitted because what precedes indicates it.

daas-irab:89-89.t:
﴿قَدِ﴾: a particle of realization. ﴿افْتَرَيْنا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, to which the following preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ are attached; ﴿نا﴾ is its fāʿil (agent) and ﴿كَذِباً﴾ its object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a jussive conditional particle. ﴿عُدْنا﴾: a past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is its agent; it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) — or it is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, as with the verb أو لتعودنّ.
﴿فِي مِلَّتِكُمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb عدنا.
﴿بَعْدَ﴾: an adverb of time, likewise attached to the verb عدنا. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb for past time, indeclinable on the sukūn.
﴿نَجَّانَا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif; (نا) is an attached pronoun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the name of Majesty, agent. ﴿مِنْها﴾: attached to the verb نجانا, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation). ﴿وَما يَكُونُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, ما is negative, and يكون is a defective imperfect verb. ﴿لَنا﴾: attached to an omitted khabar (predicate).
﴿أَنْ نَعُودَ﴾: an governing the accusative and an accusative imperfect verb; the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb is in the position of the nominative as the noun of يكون.
﴿فِيها﴾: attached to the verb نعود. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿أَنْ يَشاءَ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an, and the name of Majesty is its agent. ﴿رَبُّنا﴾: badal (substitute), nominative. The interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the accusative by exception, the implied sense being: "it is not for us to return to it except in the case of Allah's willing". ﴿وَسِعَ رَبُّنا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ﴾: a past verb, its agent and its object. ﴿عِلْماً﴾: tamyīz (specification), accusative; the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾: attached to توكلنا. ﴿تَوَكَّلْنا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and نا is its agent. ﴿رَبُّنا﴾: the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, and (نا) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿افْتَحْ﴾: a verb of supplication, and the agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you". ﴿بَيْنَنا﴾: an adverb of place attached to the verb before it. ﴿وَبَيْنَ﴾: conjoined. ﴿قَوْمِنا﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (نا) is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾: attached to the verb افتح, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْفاتِحِينَ﴾: the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿الْفاتِحِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:90-90.t:
﴿وَقالَ الْمَلَأُ﴾ ...: its i'rab has preceded in verse 88. ﴿لَئِنِ﴾: the lām is the one that prepares for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam). ﴿إن﴾: a jussive conditional particle.
﴿اتَّبَعْتُمْ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; the tāʾ is its fāʿil (agent) and the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿شُعَيْباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنَّكُمْ﴾: inna is a particle resembling the verb; the kāf is its noun and the mīm is for the plural. ﴿إِذاً﴾: a particle of answer and requital. ﴿لَخاسِرُونَ﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw, and the nūn is in compensation for the tanwīn in the singular noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the nominal clause has no grammatical position, being the response to the oath, and the apodosis of the condition is omitted because the oath indicates it, according to the rule: "when a condition and an oath come together, the response belongs to whichever of them comes first".

daas-irab:91-92.t:
﴿فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ﴾: its i'rab has preceded in verse 78. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿كَذَّبُوا شُعَيْباً﴾: a past verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿كَأَنْ﴾: lightened from كأن, which resembles the verb; its noun is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn). ﴿لَمْ يَغْنَوْا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the agent. ﴿فِيهَا﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) يغنوا; the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of كأن, and the nominal clause كأن ... is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ الذين. ﴿كانُوا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿هُمُ﴾: a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.
﴿الْخاسِرِينَ﴾: khabar, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is a khabar of the relative noun.

daas-irab:93-93.t: ﴿فَتَوَلَّى عَنْهُمْ﴾ ....: its i'rab has preceded in verse 79. ﴿فَكَيْفَ﴾: an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥ, in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial); the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa. ﴿آسى﴾: a past verb [Translator's note: so in the source; آسى is a first-person imperfect verb], indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif because of impossibility (taʿadhdhur) [Translator's note: so in the source; as an imperfect it would be nominative with the ḍamma implied on the alif], and the following preposition and its genitive noun are attached to it. ﴿كافِرِينَ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa), genitive with the yāʾ; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition.

daas-irab:94-94.t:
﴿وَما أَرْسَلْنا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is negative; أرسلنا is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿فِي قَرْيَةٍ﴾ are attached, and (نا) is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ نَبِيٍّ﴾: من is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿نَبِيٍّ﴾: a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَخَذْنا﴾: a past verb and its agent. ﴿أَهْلَها﴾: its object. ﴿بِالْبَأْساءِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.
﴿وَالضَّرَّاءِ﴾: conjoined. The clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), with qad assumed before it: "We sent not .... except in the state of Our having seized". ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾: لعل, and the hāʾ is its noun; the clause ﴿يَضَّرَّعُونَ﴾ is its khabar (predicate), and the clause لعلهم is explanatory (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:95-95.t: ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿بَدَّلْنا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and (نا) is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مَكانَ﴾: its first object. ﴿السَّيِّئَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْحَسَنَةَ﴾: its second object. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and of the genitive. ﴿عَفَوْا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, and the wāw is the agent. The interpreted maṣdar formed from the an implied after حتى and the verb is in the position of the genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb بدلنا; the clause بدلنا is conjoined. ﴿وَقالُوا﴾: conjoined to عفوا. ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of realization. ﴿مَسَّ آباءَنَا﴾: a past verb and mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الضَّرَّاءُ﴾: agent. ﴿وَالسَّرَّاءُ﴾: conjoined, and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَأَخَذْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its agent and its object, and the verb is conjoined to عفوا. ﴿بَغْتَةً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), or a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause ﴿لا يَشْعُرُونَ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate), and the clause وهم لا يشعرون is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl.

daas-irab:96-96.t: ﴿وَلَوْ﴾: a non-jussive conditional particle; the wāw is resumptive. ﴿أَنَّ أَهْلَ﴾: anna and its noun. ﴿الْقُرى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ is its khabar (predicate). The interpreted maṣdar formed from anna, its noun and its khabar is in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb, the implied sense being: "and if the faith of the people of the towns were established ....". ﴿وَاتَّقَوْا﴾: conjoined to آمنوا .... ﴿لَفَتَحْنا﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of the condition; فتحنا is a past verb to which the following preposition and its genitive noun are attached. ﴿ونا﴾: its agent. ﴿بَرَكاتٍ﴾: its object, accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of بركات.. and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive conditional. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾: a particle of rectification (istidrāk), and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿كَذَّبُوا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is its agent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَأَخَذْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its agent and its object. ﴿بِما﴾: ما is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. Or ما is maṣdarī.. ﴿كانُوا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw is its noun; the clause ﴿يَكْسِبُونَ﴾ is the khabar, and the clause كانوا is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:97-97.t: ﴿أَفَأَمِنَ﴾: a past verb; the fāʾ is a conjunction and the hamza is interrogative; the clause is conjoined to the clause أخذناهم. ﴿أَهْلُ﴾: fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْقُرى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ﴾: an accusative imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is its object; the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the implied sense being "the coming of Our might". ﴿بَأْسُنا﴾: agent. ﴿بَياتاً﴾: an adverb of time, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) meaning "spending the night". The nominal clause ﴿وَهُمْ نائِمُونَ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl.

daas-irab:98-98.t: The i'rab of this verse is like the one before it. ﴿ضُحًى﴾: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before it.

daas-irab:99-99.t:
﴿أَفَأَمِنُوا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the fāʾ is a conjunction and the hamza is interrogative. ﴿مَكْرَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لا is negative. ﴿يَأْمَنُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the agent is "he" [Translator's note: so in the source; the agent is the overt القوم below].
﴿مَكْرَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الْقَوْمُ﴾: agent. ﴿الْخاسِرُونَ﴾: adjective (ṣifa).

daas-irab:100-100.t:
﴿أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the wāw is a conjunction and the hamza is interrogative.
﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَرِثُونَ الْأَرْضَ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: attached to يرثون. ﴿أَهْلِها﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation). ﴿أَنْ﴾: lightened from anna; its noun is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), its implied form being أنه. ﴿لَوْ﴾: a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿نَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the agent is latent (mustatir); the clause نشاء is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) [Translator's note: so in the source; it is usually the whole conditional sentence that is taken as the khabar], and an with its noun and its khabar is interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of the nominative as the agent of يهد, or in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the agent of يهد being a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he", referring to Allah. ﴿أَصَبْناهُمْ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ﴾: a past verb to which the following preposition and its genitive noun are attached; (نا) is its agent and the hāʾ its object; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive conditional. ﴿وَنَطْبَعُ عَلى قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "we" (نحن), and the wāw is resumptive. ﴿فَهُمْ﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لا يَسْمَعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the agent and (لا) is negative; the clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar, and the nominal clause (فهم لا يسمعون) is conjoined.

daas-irab:184-184.t: ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, the wāw is a conjunction, and لم is a particle of negation, jussive and conversion (to the past). ﴿يَتَفَكَّرُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما﴾: negating. ﴿بِصاحِبِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) جنة. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿جِنَّةٍ﴾: a noun genitive in form and nominative in position, as mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb يتفكروا, which has been suspended (ʿulliqa) from governing because of the negating ما. ﴿إِنْ﴾: negating, with no governing effect. ﴿هُوَ﴾: a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿نَذِيرٌ﴾: khabar. ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾: ṣifa (adjective); the nominal clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).

daas-irab:185-185.t:
﴿أَوَلَمْ يَنْظُرُوا﴾..: its i'rab is like the i'rab of the previous verse. ﴿وَما﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive governed by an implied في, and it is conjoined to ملكوت. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَما خَلَقَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent). The verbal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). And ﴿أَنْ﴾: the lightened أن, its noun being the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), i.e. "وأنه". ﴿عَسى﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, its noun a latent (mustatir) pronoun; and the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and ﴿اقْتَرَبَ أَجَلُهُمْ﴾, the incomplete verb يكون with أن before it, is in the position of the accusative as its khabar (predicate). The noun of يكون is also a latent pronoun, and the verbal clause is in the position of the accusative as its khabar. «[Translator's note: so in the source; the passage appears to assume an implied أن يكون before اقترب أجلهم and is somewhat disordered.]»
﴿فَبِأَيِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb يؤمنون; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition). ﴿حَدِيثٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بَعْدَهُ﴾: attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of حديث; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil.

daas-irab:186-186.t: ﴿مَنْ﴾: a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the verbal clause ﴿يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause من يضلل is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and لا is the lā of generic negation. ﴿هادِيَ﴾: its noun. ﴿لَهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar, or to the active participle هادي, the khabar being omitted. ﴿وَيَذَرُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is "هو", and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl (object); the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿فِي طُغْيانِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يعمهون; the clause يذرهم is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause ﴿يَعْمَهُونَ﴾ is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

daas-irab:187-187.t:
﴿يَسْئَلُونَكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عَنِ السَّاعَةِ﴾ are attached (mutaʿalliq); the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and the kāf its mafʿūl (object); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿أَيَّانَ﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as an adverb of time, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿مُرْساها﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the nominal clause is a badal (substitute) from الساعة.
﴿قُلْ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّما﴾: the restraining particle and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿عِلْمُها﴾: mubtadaʾ, and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place, attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿رَبِّي﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿يُجَلِّيها﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿لِوَقْتِها﴾ are attached, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl. ﴿إِلَّا هُوَ﴾: إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and هو is the fāʿil. The clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).
And the clause ﴿ثَقُلَتْ فِي السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ is resumptive. ﴿لا تَأْتِيكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the kāf is its mafʿūl; لا is negating. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction. ﴿بَغْتَةً﴾: ḥāl; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَسْئَلُونَكَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَأَنَّكَ﴾: كأن, and the kāf is its noun. ﴿حَفِيٌّ عَنْها﴾: its khabar, to which the preposition and its genitive noun عنهابها ﴿إِنَّما﴾ are attached «[Translator's note: so in the source; the text here appears garbled ("عنهابها" followed by a stray ﴿إِنَّما﴾); presumably only عنها is meant.]», and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِنَّما﴾: kāffa wa-makfūfa. ﴿عِلْمُها﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿عِنْدَ اللَّهِ﴾: an adverb of place, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ﴾: lākinna and its noun, and the clause يعلمون is its khabar. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and لا is negating.

daas-irab:188-188.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِي نَفْعاً﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and نفعا is its mafʿūl (object); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَلا ضَرًّا﴾: conjoined. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as the excepted (mustathnā), and the verbal clause ﴿شاءَ اللَّهُ﴾ is its ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَلَوْ﴾: a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿كُنْتُ﴾: kāna and its noun. And the clause ﴿أَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ﴾ is its khabar (predicate). And the clause ﴿لَاسْتَكْثَرْتُ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿مَسَّنِيَ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person «[Translator's note: so in the source.]», and the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the nūn is for protection (wiqāya). ﴿السُّوءُ﴾: fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنْ﴾: negating. ﴿أَنَا﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿نَذِيرٌ﴾: khabar. ﴿وَبَشِيرٌ﴾: conjoined; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بشير. And the clause ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ is in the position of the genitive as a ṣifa (adjective).

daas-irab:189-189.t: ﴿هُوَ﴾: a detached nominative pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿خَلَقَكُمْ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿مِنْ نَفْسٍ﴾ are attached (mutaʿalliq); its fāʿil (agent) is "هو" and the kāf is its mafʿūl (object). ﴿واحِدَةٍ﴾: ṣifa (adjective); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. And the clause ﴿وَجَعَلَ مِنْها زَوْجَها﴾ is conjoined. ﴿لِيَسْكُنَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of cause (lām al-taʿlīl); the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive governed by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to جعل. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: adverbial (ẓarfiyya) and conditional, and the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿تَغَشَّاها﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility; the hāʾ is its mafʿūl, and the fāʿil is "هو"; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿حَمَلَتْ﴾: a past verb with the tāʾ of the feminine, and its fāʿil is "هي". ﴿حَمْلًا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) if considered a maṣdar (verbal noun), and mafʿūl bihi (direct object) if it is not a maṣdar. ﴿خَفِيفاً﴾: ṣifa; the clause has no grammatical position, being the answer to لما; and the clause ﴿فَمَرَّتْ بِهِ﴾ is conjoined. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: temporal (ḥīniyya) and conditional. ﴿أَثْقَلَتْ﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿دَعَوَا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, and the alif of the dual is the fāʿil. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty, its mafʿūl. ﴿رَبَّهُما﴾: badal (substitute); the clause is the answer to لما, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَئِنْ﴾: the lām prepares for an oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and إن is a jussive conditional. ﴿آتَيْتَنا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn; the tāʾ is its fāʿil and نا its mafʿūl. ﴿صالِحاً﴾: a ṣifa of an omitted mafʿūl bihi, i.e. "ولدا صالحا" (a righteous child); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿لَنَكُونَنَّ﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis. ﴿مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of the incomplete verb; the clause has no grammatical position, being the answer to the oath. It has made the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) unnecessary; and the clause of the oath with its answer is explicative (mufassira) of the clause دعوا الله..

daas-irab:190-190.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: لما is adverbial (ẓarfiyya) and conditional. ﴿آتاهُما﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is "هو", and the hāʾ is its first object, and ما is for the dual. ﴿صالِحاً﴾: a ṣifa (adjective) of a second object, i.e. "ولدا صالحا" (a righteous child); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿جَعَلا لَهُ شُرَكاءَ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the alif is its fāʿil, and ﴿شُرَكاءَ﴾ is its mafʿūl (object); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿فِيما﴾: ما is a relative noun in the position of the genitive governed by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ṣifa of شركاء, and the clause ﴿آتاهُما﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَتَعالَى اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ﴾: ما is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), and together with the verb after it it is interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of the genitive governed by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb, i.e. "Allah is exalted above their association (of partners)".

daas-irab:191-191.t: ﴿أَيُشْرِكُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and the hamza is for interrogation. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لا يَخْلُقُ شَيْئاً﴾: an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); لا is negating, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. And the clause ﴿أَيُشْرِكُونَ﴾ is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿يُخْلَقُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb in the passive, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ هم, and the nominal clause وهم يخلقون is circumstantial.

daas-irab:192-192.t: ﴿وَلا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and its fāʿil (agent); لا is negating with no governing effect. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from نصرا. ﴿نَصْراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلا أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَنْصُرُونَ﴾: the verbal clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:193-193.t:
﴿وَإِنْ﴾: conditional. ﴿تَدْعُوهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ its mafʿūl (object).
﴿إِلَى الْهُدى﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿لا يَتَّبِعُوكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and لا is negating; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined to the fāʾ or to the إذا of surprise.
﴿سَواءٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, or khabar (predicate) with what follows it as mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to سواء; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿أَدَعَوْتُمُوهُمْ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is attached to the tāʾ of the agent; the tāʾ is an attached pronoun, indeclinable on the sukūn «[Translator's note: so in the source; the tāʾ here is indeclinable on the ḍamma.]», in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm is for the masculine plural; the ḍamma has been lengthened so that it became a wāw.
The hamza is for equalisation (taswiya) and interrogation, and together with the verb after it it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ, or as mubtadaʾ with سواء as khabar. ﴿أَمْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿صامِتُونَ﴾: khabar; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:194-194.t:
