﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna. ﴿تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عِبادٌ﴾: khabar (predicate). ﴿أَمْثالُكُمْ﴾: ṣifa (adjective).
﴿فَادْعُوهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ its mafʿūl (object); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. And the clause ﴿فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا﴾ is conjoined. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿إِنَّ﴾: conditional «[Translator's note: so in the source, with the word written as إِنَّ; the conditional particle in the verse is إِنْ.]». ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ being its noun; it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿صادِقِينَ﴾: its khabar; the clause of the protasis has no grammatical position, being initial (ibtidāʾiyya), and the apodosis is omitted because what precedes indicates it.

daas-irab:195-195.t:
﴿أَلَهُمْ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿أَرْجُلٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya).
And the clause ﴿يَمْشُونَ بِها﴾ is in the position of the nominative as a ṣifa (adjective). Likewise is the i'rab of the other clauses, namely ﴿أَمْ لَهُمْ أَيْدٍ يَبْطِشُونَ بِها أَمْ لَهُمْ أَعْيُنٌ يُبْصِرُونَ بِها أَمْ لَهُمْ آذانٌ يَسْمَعُونَ بِها﴾
. ﴿أَيْدٍ﴾: mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the deleted yāʾ. ﴿قُلِ﴾: the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿ادْعُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿شُرَكاءَكُمْ﴾: its mafʿūl (object); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿كِيدُونِ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the deleted yāʾ is its mafʿūl; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَلا﴾: لا is prohibitive. ﴿تُنْظِرُونِ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn.

daas-irab:196-196.t: ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿وَلِيِّيَ﴾: the noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, its khabar (predicate). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: the relative noun is in the position of the nominative as a ṣifa (adjective), and the clause ﴿نَزَّلَ الْكِتابَ﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: هو is a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَتَوَلَّى الصَّالِحِينَ﴾: the clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

daas-irab:197-197.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a relative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is conjoined. ﴿تَدْعُونَ﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; and the clause ﴿لا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَكُمْ﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. See the i'rab of verse (10). «[Translator's note: so in the source; the parallel wording is in verse 192.]»

daas-irab:198-198.t:
﴿وَإِنْ تَدْعُوهُمْ﴾: see verse 193.. ﴿وَتَراهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir) and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl (object); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿يَنْظُرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil.
﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), and likewise the nominal clause after it ﴿وَهُمْ لا يُبْصِرُونَ﴾; and the verbal clause لا يبصرون is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) هم.

daas-irab:199-199.t: ﴿خُذِ الْعَفْوَ﴾: an imperative verb and its mafʿūl (object), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". ﴿وَأْمُرْ بِالْعُرْفِ﴾: an imperative verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun بالعفو «[Translator's note: so in the source; بالعرف is meant.]» are attached (mutaʿalliq); its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is conjoined; and likewise ﴿وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْجاهِلِينَ﴾.

daas-irab:200-200.t:
﴿وَإِمَّا﴾: the conditional إن and a redundant (zāʾida) ما, and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿يَنْزَغَنَّكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the kāf is its mafʿūl (object); the clause of the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنَ الشَّيْطانِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from نزع «[Translator's note: so in the source; نزغ is meant.]»; it was a ṣifa (adjective) of it, and when it was placed before it, it became a ḥāl. ﴿نَزْغٌ﴾: fāʿil (agent). ﴿فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and an imperative verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿إِنَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾: inna, its noun and its two khabars (predicates); the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:201-201.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾: inna, and the relative noun is its noun. ﴿اتَّقَوْا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb for future time, putting its protasis in the genitive (by annexation) and accusative by its apodosis. ﴿مَسَّهُمْ طائِفٌ﴾: a past verb, its mafʿūl (object) and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿مِنَ الشَّيْطانِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of طائف. ﴿تَذَكَّرُوا﴾: a past verb and fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿فَإِذا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إذا is the إذا of surprise. ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مُبْصِرُونَ﴾: its khabar; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:202-202.t: ﴿وَإِخْوانُهُمْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a nominative mubtadaʾ (subject); the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿يَمُدُّونَهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl (object), and the mīm is for the masculine plural; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿فِي الغَيِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿لا يُقْصِرُونَ﴾: لا is negating; an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. And لا is negating; the clause is conjoined to the resumptive clause before it.

daas-irab:203-204.t: ﴿إِذا﴾: its i'rab has preceded in 201. ﴿لَمْ تَأْتِهِمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl (object). ﴿بِآيَةٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is in the position of [the genitive] by annexation (iḍāfa). «[Translator's note: the word "genitive" (جر) is missing in the source.]» ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the answer to إذا, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَوْلا﴾: a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿اجْتَبَيْتَها﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb. ﴿إِنَّما﴾: the restraining particle and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿أَتَّبِعُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿يُوحى﴾: an imperfect verb in the passive, to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿إِلَيَّ﴾ are attached, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿هذا بَصائِرُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of بصائر. ﴿وَهُدىً﴾ ﴿وَرَحْمَةٌ﴾: conjoined. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to رحمة. ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ṣifa of قوم. ﴿وَإِذا﴾: see verse 201. ﴿قُرِئَ الْقُرْآنُ﴾: a past verb in the passive and its nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿فَاسْتَمِعُوا﴾: an imperative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿لَهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَأَنْصِتُوا﴾: conjoined. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ﴾: لعل and its noun, and the clause ﴿تُرْحَمُونَ﴾ is its khabar; the clause لعلكم is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:205-205.t: ﴿وَاذْكُرْ رَبَّكَ﴾: an imperative verb and its mafʿūl (object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي نَفْسِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿تَضَرُّعاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial) or mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿وَخِيفَةً﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَدُونَ﴾: an adverb of place, attached to an omitted word conjoined to خيفة, the implied form being "وداعيا دون الجهر" (and calling without loudness).. من القول: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun) before them. ﴿بِالْغُدُوِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اذكر.. ﴿وَالْآصالِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَلا تَكُنْ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the sukūn because it is preceded by the prohibitive لا. The noun of تكن is omitted. ﴿مِنَ الْغافِلِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the incomplete verb; the clause is conjoined to the clause واذكر..

daas-irab:206-206.t: ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause): "الذين قرّبوا" (those who have been brought near). ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the kāf is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the nominal clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the verbal clause ﴿لا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿عَنْ عِبادَتِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; and the clause ﴿يُسَبِّحُونَهُ﴾ is conjoined. ﴿وَلَهُ يَسْجُدُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the preposition and its genitive noun before it are attached to the verb, and the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:101-101.t:
﴿تِلْكَ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasr, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿الْقُرى﴾: badal (substitute), nominative with the ḍamma implied on the alif because of impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, as ﴿مِنْ أَنْبائِها﴾ is also attached to it; its fāʿil (agent) is "we" (نحن), and the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ تلك. It is also permissible to parse القرى as khabar and the clause after it as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath. ﴿قد﴾: a particle of realization. ﴿جاءَتْهُمْ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥ; the tāʾ is for the feminine, the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural. ﴿رُسُلُهُمْ﴾: agent; the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation), and the mīm is for the plural. ﴿بِالْبَيِّناتِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them; the clause has no grammatical position, being the response to the oath, and the implied oath clause together with its response is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَما﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ما is negative. ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿لِيُؤْمِنُوا﴾: the lām is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd). ﴿يؤمنوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of denial, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the agent; the interpreted maṣdar formed from the implied an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of كانوا, i.e., "they were not ones wanting faith".
﴿بِما﴾: [ما is] a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. Or (ما) is maṣdarī, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from it and the verb after it, ﴿كَذَّبُوا﴾, is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, i.e., "because of their denial", and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb يؤمنوا. On the first view, the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a preposition. ﴿قَبْلُ﴾: an adverb of time, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the genitive, because it is cut off from annexation. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾: the kāf is a preposition. ﴿ذا﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of an implied mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e., "Allah seals the hearts of the disbelievers with a sealing like His sealing of the hearts of those before". ﴿يَطْبَعُ اللَّهُ عَلى قُلُوبِ..﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the name of Majesty is its agent. ﴿الْكافِرِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the verbal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:102-102.t: ﴿وَما﴾: negative, with no governing effect; the wāw is resumptive. ﴿وَجَدْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿لِأَكْثَرِهِمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb وجدنا, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿مِنْ عَهْدٍ﴾; it was an adjective (ṣifa) of it, and when placed before it, it became a ḥāl, according to the rule. ﴿مِنْ عَهْدٍ﴾: من is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and عهد is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: lightened from the heavy [inna], with no governing effect, because a verb follows it; for this reason the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa) comes after it, which distinguishes between the negative [in] and the lightened [in]. ﴿وَجَدْنا﴾: a past verb and agent. ﴿أَكْثَرَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فاسقين﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, and the lām is the distinguishing lām; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:103-103.t: ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction conveying delay (tarākhī). ﴿بَعَثْنا﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ﴾ are attached, and (نا) is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مُوسى﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the fatḥa implied on the alif because of impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from موسى, or to the verb. ﴿إِلى فِرْعَوْنَ﴾: [فرعون is] a genitive noun, [genitive] with the fatḥa in place of the kasra, a diptote because it is a proper noun and non-Arab; the two are attached to بعثنا, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَمَلَائِهِ﴾: a conjoined noun. ﴿فَظَلَمُوا بِها﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is the agent. The fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كانَ....﴾: its i'rab has preceded in verse 84.

daas-irab:104-104.t:
﴿وَقالَ مُوسى﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent); the wāw is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive.
﴿يا فِرْعَوْنُ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: inna, and the yāʾ is its noun. ﴿رَسُولٌ﴾: its khabar (predicate).
﴿مِنْ رَبِّ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of رسول. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the nominal clause "إني رسول ...." is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:105-105.t:
﴿حَقِيقٌ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "I am worthy" (أنا حقيق). ﴿عَلى﴾: a preposition. ﴿أَنْ﴾: a particle governing the accusative. ﴿لا أَقُولَ﴾: an accusative imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) being "I" (أنا); لا is negative, with no governing effect. The interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by على.
The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) حقيق, because it has the sense of a passive or an active participle. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾: attached to أقول. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الْحَقَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative. ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of realization. ﴿جِئْتُكُمْ بِبَيِّنَةٍ﴾: a past verb to which the following preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the tāʾ is its agent and the kāf its object. ﴿فَأَرْسِلْ﴾: an imperative, and the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa; the agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you". ﴿مَعِيَ﴾: an adverb of place, accusative with the fatḥa implied on the letter before the first-person yāʾ; the yāʾ is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation), and it is attached to أرسل. ﴿بَنِي﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; the nūn was dropped for annexation, and it is a muḍāf. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the fatḥa in place of the kasra, a diptote, being a non-Arab proper noun; the verbal clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition: "if you know that, then send the Children of Israel with me".

daas-irab:106-106.t:
﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a jussive conditional particle. ﴿كُنْتَ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun. ﴿جِئْتَ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of كنت. ﴿بِآيَةٍ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) جئت.
﴿فَأْتِ﴾: the fāʾ is linking, and [ائت] is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter because it is weak-final; the agent is "you". ﴿بِها﴾: attached to the verb before them. ﴿إِنْ﴾: conditional. ﴿كُنْتَ﴾: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ﴾: attached to an omitted khabar; the apodosis of the condition is omitted because what precedes indicates it.

daas-irab:107-108.t: ﴿فَأَلْقى﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied on the alif; the fāʿil (agent) is "he". ﴿عَصاهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the fatḥa implied on the alif; the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَإِذا﴾: إذا of surprise (al-fujāʾiyya), and the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿هِيَ﴾: a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿ثُعْبانٌ﴾: khabar (predicate). ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾: adjective (ṣifa), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَإِذا هِيَ بَيْضاءُ﴾ ....: like the one before it. ﴿لِلنَّاظِرِينَ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) بيضاء.

daas-irab:109-109.t: ﴿قالَ الْمَلَأُ﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ قَوْمِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الملأ. ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a proper noun and non-Arab. The clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ هذا﴾: inna, and the demonstrative is its noun. ﴿لَساحِرٌ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿ساحر﴾: its khabar (predicate). ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾: adjective (ṣifa), and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl)..

daas-irab:110-110.t:
﴿يُرِيدُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he"; the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أَنْ﴾, which governs the accusative, and the verb ﴿يُخْرِجَكُمْ﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْ أَرْضِكُمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb يخرجكم, and the clause يريد is in the position of the nominative as a second khabar (predicate).
﴿فَماذا﴾: an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi. The fāʾ is the faṣīḥa.
﴿تَأْمُرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the agent, and its object is omitted, its implied form being "you command us" (تأمروننا). The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.

daas-irab:111-112.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَرْجِهْ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn implied on the hamza dropped for lightness — أرجئه; the hāʾ is an attached pronoun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you". ﴿وَأَخاهُ﴾: a noun conjoined to the hāʾ, accusative with the alif because it is one of the five nouns. The hāʾ is an attached pronoun, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَأَرْسِلْ﴾: an imperative verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿فِي الْمَدائِنِ﴾ are attached. The agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you". ﴿حاشِرِينَ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial) or mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the yāʾ. ﴿يَأْتُوكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the response to the request أرسل. The wāw is the agent and the kāf the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِكُلِّ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) يأتوك. ﴿ساحِرٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَلِيمٍ﴾: adjective (ṣifa); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a condition not joined to the fāʾ.

daas-irab:113-113.t: ﴿وَجاءَ السَّحَرَةُ﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and agent, and the clause is likewise resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ لَنا﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿لَأَجْراً﴾: its noun; the lām is the lām of commencement (lām al-ibtidāʾ), and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنَّ﴾ [Translator's note: so vowelled in the source; the word meant is the conditional إِنْ]: a jussive conditional particle. ﴿كُنَّا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and نا is its noun. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾: a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, or a tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun نا. ﴿الْغالِبِينَ﴾: the khabar of كنا, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes indicating it.

daas-irab:114-114.t: ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he", referring to Pharaoh; the clause is resumptive. ﴿نَعَمْ﴾: a particle of answer, which takes the place of saying "indeed you will have a reward".. ﴿وَإِنَّكُمْ﴾: inna, and the kāf is its noun; the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿لَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ﴾ are attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to the omitted, implied clause.

daas-irab:115-115.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا مُوسى﴾: the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied on the shortened alif (alif maqṣūra), in the position of the accusative. ﴿إِمَّا﴾: a particle of condition and detailing, conveying choice. ﴿أَنْ تُلْقِيَ﴾: an accusative imperfect verb; the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb is in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), the implied sense being: "either your throwing is begun with, or our throwing ...". ﴿أَنْ﴾: governing the accusative. ﴿نَكُونَ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "we" (نحن). ﴿نَحْنُ﴾: a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), or a tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent pronoun. ﴿الْمُلْقِينَ﴾: khabar (predicate), and the maṣdar is conjoined.

daas-irab:116-116.t: ﴿قالَ﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿أَلْقُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: a conditional adverb, and the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿أَلْقُوا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied on the alif dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the wāw is the agent, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation). ﴿سَحَرُوا﴾: a past verb and agent, and the clause is the response to لما. ﴿أَعْيُنَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿النَّاسِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَاسْتَرْهَبُوهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its agent and its object, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَجاؤُ﴾: a past verb and its agent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِسِحْرٍ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿عَظِيمٍ﴾: adjective (ṣifa), and the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:117-117.t:
﴿وَأَوْحَيْنا﴾: a past verb to which the following preposition and its genitive noun ﴿إِلى مُوسى﴾ are attached, and (نا) is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَنْ﴾: a particle of explanation.
﴿أَلْقِ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; the agent is "you". ﴿عَصاكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa implied on the alif; the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation); the clause is explicative, with no grammatical position. It is also permissible for an to be maṣdarī, the interpreted maṣdar being a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فَإِذا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction and إذا is of surprise (al-fujāʾiyya). ﴿هِيَ﴾: a detached nominative pronoun, indeclinable on the fatḥ, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿تَلْقَفُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose agent is "she"; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause (هي تلقف) is conjoined to an implied clause: "so he threw it, and behold, it ....". ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the clause ﴿يَأْفِكُونَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause); or ما is maṣdarī, interpreted together with the verb after it as a maṣdar in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi: ﴿تلقف إفكهم﴾ "it swallows their falsehood".

daas-irab:118-119.t: ﴿فَوَقَعَ الْحَقُّ﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَبَطَلَ ما﴾: a past verb, and the relative noun is the agent. Or ما is maṣdarī, interpreted together with the verb after it as a maṣdar in the position of the nominative as the agent of بطل. ﴿كانُوا﴾: the wāw is its noun, and the clause ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) [Translator's note: so in the source; elsewhere this book places the khabar of kāna in the accusative position]. The clause كانوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿فَغُلِبُوا﴾: a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿هُنالِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as an adverb of place; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. The clause is conjoined. ﴿وَانْقَلَبُوا﴾: a past verb and its agent. ﴿صاغِرِينَ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with the yāʾ, and the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:120-122.t:
﴿وَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ﴾: a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿ساجِدِينَ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause is conjoined.
﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, or circumstantial with qad assumed before it, i.e., "saying". ﴿آمَنَّا﴾: a past verb and agent, and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بِرَبِّ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمنا. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿رَبِّ﴾: badal (substitute) of the رب before it.
﴿مُوسى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the kasra implied on the alif because of impossibility (taʿadhdhur).
﴿وَهارُونَ﴾: a conjoined noun, genitive with the fatḥa in place of the kasra, being a non-Arab proper noun.

daas-irab:1-1.t: ﴿المص﴾: in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject); or [separate] letters with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:2-2.t:
﴿كِتابٌ﴾: its khabar (predicate), or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أُنْزِلَ﴾: a passive past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ are attached (mutaʿalliq); the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir). The clause is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as an adjective (ṣifa) of كتاب. ﴿فَلا يَكُنْ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) with sukūn; لا is the prohibitive, jussive-governing lā, and the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿فِي صَدْرِكَ﴾: attached to the omitted khabar of يكن.
﴿حَرَجٌ﴾: its noun. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: attached to an omitted adjective of حرج; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لِتُنْذِرَ﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the implied an and the verb is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb أنزل. ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَذِكْرى﴾: a noun conjoined to the interpreted maṣdar, i.e. "for warning and reminder"; it is also said to be conjoined to كتاب. ﴿لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: a noun, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the maṣdar ذكرى.

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿اتَّبِعُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and the relative noun ﴿ما﴾ is its object. ﴿إِلَيْكُمْ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to أنزل. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of the passive verb أنزل; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا تَتَّبِعُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and لا is the prohibitive, jussive-governing lā. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾: attached to the verb before them, or to an omitted ḥāl from أولياء: it was an adjective of it, and when it was placed before it, it became a ḥāl. ﴿أَوْلِياءَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), or of an omitted adverb, i.e. "a little remembering" or "a little time". ﴿ما تَذَكَّرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and ما is redundant (zāʾida). The clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:4-4.t:
﴿وَكَمْ﴾: كم is the declarative kam (kam khabariyya), indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿قَرْيَةٍ﴾: a noun genitive in form and accusative (manṣūb) in position as tamyīz (specification). ﴿أَهْلَكْناها﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate).
﴿فَجاءَها بَأْسُنا﴾: a past verb, its object and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بَياتاً﴾: an adverb, or a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿هُمْ قائِلُونَ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is conjoined to بياتا, so it is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.

daas-irab:5-5.t: ﴿فَما﴾: ما is negating and the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿كانَ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿دَعْواهُمْ﴾: the noun of kāna, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the hāʾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb for past time, attached (mutaʿalliq) to دعواهم. ﴿جاءَهُمْ بَأْسُنا﴾: a past verb, its object and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ قالُوا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the khabar (predicate) of kāna. ﴿إِنَّا﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿كُنَّا﴾: kāna and its noun, and ﴿ظالِمِينَ﴾ is its khabar; the clause كنا ظالمين is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.

daas-irab:6-6.t: ﴿فَلَنَسْئَلَنَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the lām is the lām of the oath, and the fāʾ is a resumptive particle. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause has no grammatical position, being the answer to the oath. ﴿أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ﴾: a passive imperfect verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: so in the source; أُرْسِلَ is a past verb.] ﴿وَلَنَسْئَلَنَّ﴾: its parsing has gone before. ﴿الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:7-7.t: ﴿فَلَنَقُصَّنَّ﴾: like فلنسألن. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb before them. ﴿بِعِلْمٍ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial): "explaining with knowledge". ﴿وَما كُنَّا غائِبِينَ﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar (predicate); ما is negating; the clause is conjoined or circumstantial.

daas-irab:8-8.t: ﴿الْوَزْنُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾: an adverb of time attached (mutaʿalliq) to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; إذ is an adverb for past time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and its tanwīn is a tanwīn of compensation for an omitted clause: "the day the Hour arises". ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of الوزن, or the khabar; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾: a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ; the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿ثَقُلَتْ مَوازِينُهُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾: the fāʾ is connective, and [أولئك is] a demonstrative in the position of nominative as first mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُمُ﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as second mubtadaʾ, or a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position; ﴿الْمُفْلِحُونَ﴾ is the khabar of أولئك, or the khabar of the second mubtadaʾ هم, the clause هم المفلحون being in the position of nominative as the khabar of أولئك. The clause فأولئك is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause of the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) with its apodosis is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من.

daas-irab:9-9.t: ﴿وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوازِينُهُ﴾: the verbal clause is conjoined. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the fāʾ is connective. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ أولئك; the clause stands in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause ﴿خَسِرُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِما﴾: maṣdariyya (verbal-noun particle); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ما and the defective verb ﴿كانُوا﴾ after it is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ. ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb after them, and the clause ﴿يَظْلِمُونَ﴾ is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the khabar of kāna.

daas-irab:10-10.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the lām falls in the answer to the oath, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿مَكَّنَّاكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to this verb; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿وَجَعَلْنا لَكُمْ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and نا is its fāʿil. ﴿فِيها﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from معايش: it was an adjective of it, and when it was placed before it, it became a ḥāl. ﴿مَعايِشَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun). ﴿ما﴾: redundant (zāʾida); the clause ﴿تَشْكُرُونَ﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or circumstantial.

daas-irab:123-123.t:
﴿قالَ فِرْعَوْنُ﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿آمَنْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its agent, and the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمنتم, and likewise the adverb ﴿قَبْلَ﴾. ﴿أَنْ﴾: governing the accusative. ﴿آذَنَ﴾: an accusative imperfect verb, its agent being "I" (أنا); the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: attached to آذن. ﴿أَنْ﴾ [Translator's note: so vowelled in the source; the word meant is إِنَّ]: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿هذا﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna. ﴿لَمَكْرٌ﴾: its khabar (predicate), and [the lām is] the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿مَكَرْتُمُوهُ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn; the tāʾ is the agent and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the ḍamma was lengthened and the wāw was generated from it. The clause is in the position of the nominative as an adjective (ṣifa) of مكر. ﴿فِي الْمَدِينَةِ﴾: attached to the verb before them. ﴿لِتُخْرِجُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of purpose (taʿlīl). The interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to مكرتموه.
﴿مِنْها﴾: attached to تخرجوا. ﴿أَهْلَها﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿فَسَوْفَ﴾: a particle of the future, and the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and agent, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:124-124.t: ﴿لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥ because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath. The fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "I" (أنا). ﴿أَيْدِيَكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the fatḥa; the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation), and the mīm is for the masculine plural. The verbal clause has no grammatical position, being the response to the oath. ﴿وَأَرْجُلَكُمْ﴾: conjoined. ﴿مِنْ خِلافٍ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from أيديكم ... ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿لَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ﴾: parsed like لأقطعن, and the kāf is its object. ﴿أَجْمَعِينَ﴾: tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun before it, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:125-125.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّا﴾: inna, and نا is its noun. ﴿إِلى رَبِّنا﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). ﴿مُنْقَلِبُونَ﴾: its khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the nominal clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl)..

daas-irab:126-126.t: ﴿وَما تَنْقِمُ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun منا are attached; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you". ما is negative and the wāw is resumptive, so the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ﴾: a maṣdarī particle governing the accusative. ﴿آمَنَّا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and نا is its agent; the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object): "and you resent nothing but our faith". ﴿بِآياتِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمنا. ﴿رَبِّنا﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَمَّا﴾: an adverb of time (ḥīniyya). ﴿جاءَتْنا﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and نا is mafʿūl bihi; the agent is a latent pronoun referring to the signs, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation). ﴿رَبِّنا﴾: the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative; نا is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿أَفْرِغْ﴾: a verb of supplication to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾ are attached. ﴿صَبْراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl) of the omitted [verb of saying]. ﴿وَتَوَفَّنا﴾: a verb of supplication, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter; نا is its object and the agent is "you". ﴿مُسْلِمِينَ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with the yāʾ. The clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:127-127.t:
﴿وَقالَ الْمَلَأُ﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ قَوْمِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الملأ. ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote, being a proper noun and non-Arab; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَتَذَرُ مُوسى﴾: an imperfect verb and its object; the agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you"; the hamza is interrogative, and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿وَقَوْمَهُ﴾: conjoined to موسى, accusative with the fatḥa, and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation). ﴿لِيُفْسِدُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of purpose (taʿlīl); the wāw is the agent; the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تذر. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: attached to يفسدوا. ﴿وَيَذَرَكَ﴾: an accusative imperfect verb conjoined to يفسدوا; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he". ﴿وَآلِهَتَكَ﴾: conjoined to the kāf in يذرك, and the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿سَنُقَتِّلُ أَبْناءَهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object; the agent is "we" (نحن), and the clause is the speech reported. ﴿وَنَسْتَحْيِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ, its appearance prevented by heaviness (thiqal); the agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "we". ﴿نِساءَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَإِنَّا﴾: inna and its noun, and the wāw is circumstantial. ﴿فَوْقَهُمْ﴾: an adverb of place attached to the khabar (predicate). ﴿قاهِرُونَ﴾: khabar, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl.

daas-irab:128-128.t:
﴿قالَ مُوسى لِقَوْمِهِ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun لقومه are attached, and موسى is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿اسْتَعِينُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, to which the following preposition and its genitive noun ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ are attached; the wāw is its agent, and the clause is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وَاصْبِرُوا﴾: conjoined. ﴿إِنَّ الْأَرْضَ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: the name of Majesty, genitive by the lām; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of inna, and the clause is explanatory (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿يُورِثُها﴾: an imperfect verb; the hāʾ is the first object and the relative noun ﴿مَنْ﴾ the second object; the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْ عِبادِهِ﴾: attached to يشاء.
﴿وَالْعاقِبَةُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. ﴿لِلْمُتَّقِينَ﴾: attached to an omitted khabar, and the nominal clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:129-129.t:
﴿قالُوا﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿أُوذِينا﴾: a passive past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, to which the following preposition and its genitive noun ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِ﴾ are attached; نا is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَنْ﴾: governing the accusative. ﴿تَأْتِيَنا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative with the overt fatḥa; the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation): "before your coming ....". ﴿وَمِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: conjoined to من قبل. ﴿ما جِئْتَنا﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is its fāʿil (agent) and نا its object; ما is maṣdarī, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa: "after your coming to us". ﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَسى﴾: an inflexible (jāmid) past verb.
﴿رَبُّكُمْ﴾: its noun. ﴿أَنْ يُهْلِكَ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of عسى, the implied sense being "destroying (your enemy)". ﴿وَيَسْتَخْلِفَكُمْ﴾: an accusative imperfect verb, conjoined, and the kāf is its object. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿فَيَنْظُرَ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation. ﴿ينظر﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the fāʾ of causation, and the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to the khabar "destroying" (مهلك). It is also permissible for the fāʾ to be a conjunction.. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its agent, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb ينظر.

daas-irab:130-130.t:
﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath, قد is a particle of realization, and the wāw is resumptive. ﴿أَخَذْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and ﴿آلَ﴾ is its object. ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, the sign of its genitive being the fatḥa in place of the kasra, a diptote, being a non-Arab proper noun. ﴿بِالسِّنِينَ﴾: a noun genitive by the bāʾ, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أخذنا, and the clause has no grammatical position, occurring as the response to the oath.
﴿وَنَقْصٍ﴾: conjoined to بالسنين. ﴿مِنَ الثَّمَراتِ﴾: attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun) نقص. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾: لعل; the hāʾ is its noun and the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿يَذَّكَّرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and agent, and the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of لعل. The nominal clause لعلهم يذكرون has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:131-131.t:
﴿فَإِذا﴾: a non-jussive conditional adverb, and the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿جاءَتْهُمُ الْحَسَنَةُ﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿الْحَسَنَةُ﴾ is the fāʿil (agent), and the clause is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation). ﴿قالُوا﴾: the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive conditional. ﴿لَنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿هذِهِ﴾: the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the nominal clause is a mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَإِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ﴾:
إن is conditional; تصبهم is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); سيئة is its agent and the hāʾ its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَطَّيَّرُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn, the apodosis of the condition, to which the following preposition and its genitive noun ﴿بِمُوسى﴾ are attached; the wāw is the agent, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is not joined to the fāʾ.. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive, conjoined to موسى. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾: an adverb of place attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, the implied sense being "and those who believed with him"; the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa.
﴿أَلا﴾: an opening particle (istiftāḥ). ﴿إِنَّما﴾: a restraining [mā] and a restrained [inna] (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿طائِرُهُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَلكِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb, and the wāw is circumstantial. ﴿أَكْثَرَهُمْ﴾: its noun. ﴿لا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾: a nominative imperfect verb, and the wāw is its agent. ﴿لا﴾: negative, with no governing effect; the verbal clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of lākinna. The nominal clause (ولكن أكثرهم ....) is circumstantial.

daas-irab:132-132.t:
﴿وَقالُوا﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿مَهْما﴾: a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿تَأْتِنا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter; نا is its object and its fāʿil (agent) is "you"; it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) تأتنا. ﴿مِنْ آيَةٍ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لِتَسْحَرَنا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of purpose (taʿlīl); نا is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the agent is "you"; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تأتنا. ﴿بِها﴾: attached to تسحرنا. ﴿فَما﴾: ما is negative, functioning like laysa, and the fāʾ links the apodosis of the condition مهما. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾: a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as its noun. ﴿بِمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: its khabar (predicate), and the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition.
﴿لَكَ﴾: attached to the khabar مؤمنين; the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the two conditional clauses together are the khabar of مهما.

daas-irab:133-133.t:
﴿فَأَرْسَلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَلَيْهِمُ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) أرسلنا. ﴿الطُّوفانَ﴾: its object. ﴿وَالْجَرادَ وَالْقُمَّلَ وَالضَّفادِعَ وَالدَّمَ﴾: conjoined nouns. ﴿آياتٍ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with the kasra, being a sound feminine plural. ﴿مُفَصَّلاتٍ﴾: adjective (ṣifa).
﴿فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا﴾: a past verb and agent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَكانُوا قَوْماً مُجْرِمِينَ﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar (predicate), and the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:11-11.t:
﴿وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْناكُمْ﴾: the lām falls in the answer to the oath; [خلقناكم is] a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object. ﴿ثُمَّ صَوَّرْناكُمْ﴾: conjoined. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿قُلْنا لِلْمَلائِكَةِ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and نا is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined.
﴿اسْجُدُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿لِآدَمَ﴾: a noun, genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa in place of the kasra, a diptote because it is a proper name and non-Arabic; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to اسجدوا; the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَسَجَدُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿إِبْلِيسَ﴾: the excepted, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿لَمْ﴾: jussive-governing. ﴿يَكُنْ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm); its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو). ﴿مِنَ السَّاجِدِينَ﴾: attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of يكن; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), or resumptive.

daas-irab:12-12.t:
﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما مَنَعَكَ﴾: ما is an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject); منعك is a past verb and its object, its fāʿil (agent) being "you" (أنت) [Translator's note: so in the source; the fāʿil of منعك is a latent third-person pronoun referring to ما, and the kāf ("you") is its object]; the clause is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate). ﴿أن﴾: a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle. ﴿لا﴾: redundant (zāʾida).
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the verb ﴿تَسْجُدَ﴾ and the maṣdar-forming particle before it is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by a preposition, i.e. "what prevented you from prostrating"; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb before them. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb for past time, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of accusative (manṣūb), attached to تسجد. ﴿أَمَرْتُكَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿أَنَا﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿خَيْرٌ مِنْهُ﴾: khabar, to which the following preposition and its genitive noun are attached, because it is an elative noun (ism al-tafḍīl) whose original form is أخير. ﴿خَلَقْتَنِي﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, the nūn being for protection (wiqāya); the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.
﴿مِنْ نارٍ﴾: attached to the verb before them, and the clause ﴿وَخَلَقْتَهُ﴾ is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ طِينٍ﴾: attached to the verb before them.

daas-irab:13-13.t: ﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَاهْبِطْ مِنْها﴾: an imperative verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the fāʿil (agent) is "you" (أنت), and the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida); the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَما﴾: ما is negating and the fāʾ is conjunctive. ﴿يَكُونُ﴾: a complete (tāmm) imperfect verb in the sense of "it is permissible", to which the following preposition and its genitive noun are attached. ﴿أَنْ تَتَكَبَّرَ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as fāʿil. ﴿فِيها﴾: attached to the verb before them; the clause فما يكون is conjoined. ﴿فَاخْرُجْ﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾: inna, and the kāf is its noun. ﴿مِنَ الصَّاغِرِينَ﴾: a noun, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of inna; the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:14-15.t: ﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْظِرْنِي إِلى يَوْمِ﴾: an imperative verb used for supplication, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the fāʿil (agent) is "you" (أنت), the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يُبْعَثُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause أنظرني is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِينَ﴾: like إنك من الصاغرين.

daas-irab:16-16.t:
﴿قالَ﴾: its parsing has gone before. ﴿فَبِما﴾: the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida); the bāʾ is a preposition; ما is maṣdariyya (verbal-noun particle). ﴿أَغْوَيْتَنِي﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn; the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent), the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the verb and what precedes it is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the omitted verb of oath; the oath clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿لَأَقْعُدَنَّ﴾: the lām falls in the answer to the oath; أقعدن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and its fāʿil is "I" (أنا). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: attached to أقعدن. ﴿صِراطَكَ﴾: accusative by removal of the preposition, or an adverb of place attached to the verb before it. ﴿الْمُسْتَقِيمَ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). The clause لأقعدن has no grammatical position, being the answer to the oath.

daas-irab:17-17.t:
﴿ثُمَّ﴾: conjunctive. ﴿لَآتِيَنَّهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the fāʿil (agent) is "I" (أنا), the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the lām falls in the answer to the oath. The clause has no grammatical position, being the answer to the oath. ﴿مِنْ بَيْنِ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb before them. ﴿أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ because of heaviness; the hāʾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وَعَنْ أَيْمانِهِمْ وَعَنْ شَمائِلِهِمْ﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَلا تَجِدُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); its fāʿil is "you" (أنت); لا is negating. ﴿أَكْثَرَهُمْ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿شاكِرِينَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, or a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:18-18.t:
﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿اخْرُجْ﴾ منها: an imperative verb to which the following preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); its fāʿil (agent) is "you" (أنت); the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿مَذْؤُماً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مَدْحُوراً﴾: a second ḥāl. ﴿لَمَنْ﴾: the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); من is a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿تَبِعَكَ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ are attached; its fāʿil is "he" (هو), and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَأَمْلَأَنَّ﴾: the lām falls in the answer to the oath. ﴿أملأن﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the fāʿil is "I" (أنا). ﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾: its object. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: attached to the verb before them. ﴿أَجْمَعِينَ﴾: tawkīd (emphasis), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.
The clause has no grammatical position, being the answer to the oath, and the answer to the oath has taken the place of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) and its apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.

daas-irab:19-19.t: ﴿وَيا آدَمُ﴾: يا is a vocative particle, and [آدم is] a singular proper-name one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of accusative (manṣūb); the wāw is conjunctive. ﴿اسْكُنْ﴾: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); the clause is conjoined to the clause اخرج. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾: tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent pronoun in the verb. ﴿وَزَوْجُكَ﴾: a noun conjoined to أنت. ﴿الْجَنَّةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَكُلا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the alif of the dual is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined by the fāʾ. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a preposition. ﴿حَيْثُ﴾: an adverb of place, indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of genitive (majrūr) by min; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb before them. ﴿شِئْتُما﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn; the tāʾ is the fāʿil, and mā is for the dual; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَلا تَقْرَبا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the alif is the fāʿil. ﴿هذِهِ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الشَّجَرَةَ﴾: badal (substitute), accusative with the fatḥa. ﴿فَتَكُونا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya), the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the alif of the dual is its noun. The implied an and the verb after it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) conjoined to what precedes it, the implied form being: "let there be from you no approaching, and so wrongdoing". ﴿مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: attached to an omitted khabar (predicate).

daas-irab:20-20.t:
﴿فَوَسْوَسَ لَهُمَا الشَّيْطانُ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and الشيطان is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined.
﴿لِيُبْدِيَ﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to وسوس. ﴿لَهُمَا﴾: attached to يبدي. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وُورِيَ عَنْهُما﴾: a passive past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "it" (هو). ﴿مِنْ سَوْآتِهِما﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَقالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما نَهاكُما﴾: ما is negating, and [نهاكما is] a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the kāf is its object; the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿رَبُّكُما﴾: fāʿil.
﴿عَنْ﴾: a preposition. ﴿هذِهِ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of genitive by the preposition. ﴿الشَّجَرَةِ﴾: badal (substitute), genitive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ تَكُونا مَلَكَيْنِ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb; the alif of the dual is its noun and ملكين its khabar (predicate); the interpreted maṣdar from the accusative-governing an and the verb is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e. "for dislike of your being two angels". ﴿أَوْ تَكُونا مِنَ الْخالِدِينَ﴾: conjoined.

daas-irab:21-21.t: ﴿وَقاسَمَهُما﴾: a past verb; the hāʾ is its object, the mīm and the alif are for the dual, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he" (هو), referring to Satan. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: inna, and the yāʾ of the speaker is its noun. ﴿لَكُما﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to الناصحين after it. ﴿لَمِنَ النَّاصِحِينَ﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿من النَّاصِحِينَ﴾: attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of inna. The nominal clause ﴿إِنِّي لَكُما لَمِنَ النَّاصِحِينَ﴾ has no grammatical position, being the answer to the oath, and the clause ﴿قاسَمَهُما﴾ is conjoined to the clause قال ما نهاكما.

daas-irab:22-22.t:
﴿فَدَلَّاهُما بِغُرُورٍ﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and [دلاهما is] a past verb to which the following preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the fāʿil (agent) is "he" (هو) and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: [لما is] a temporal adverb ("when"), and the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿ذاقَا الشَّجَرَةَ﴾: a past verb; the alif of the dual is its fāʿil and الشجرة its object; the clause is in the position of genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بَدَتْ لَهُما سَوْآتُهُما﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, which was dropped to avoid the meeting of two sukūns; the following preposition and its genitive noun are attached to it, and سوآتهما is the fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَطَفِقا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the alif is its noun.
﴿يَخْصِفانِ عَلَيْهِما﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the alif is its fāʿil, and a preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb, as is likewise the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿مِنْ وَرَقِ﴾. ﴿الْجَنَّةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَناداهُما رَبُّهُما﴾: a past verb, its object and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَلَمْ أَنْهَكُما﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter because it ends in a weak letter; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تِلْكُمَا﴾: تِ is a demonstrative, indeclinable on kasra, in the position of genitive by عن; the lām is for distance, the kāf for address, and mā for the dual. ﴿الشَّجَرَةَ﴾: badal (substitute). ﴿وَأَقُلْ لَكُما﴾: an imperfect verb conjoined to أنهكما, jussive like it, with sukūn; the following preposition and its genitive noun are attached to it; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّ الشَّيْطانَ لَكُما عَدُوٌّ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to عدو, and ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾
is an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:23-23.t:
﴿قالا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: a one addressed (munādā) in construct, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿ظَلَمْنا أَنْفُسَنا﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: conditional, and the wāw is conjunctive. ﴿لَمْ﴾: jussive-governing. ﴿تَغْفِرْ﴾: an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm); it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿وَتَرْحَمْنا﴾: conjoined. ﴿لَنَكُونَنَّ﴾: the lām falls in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); نكونن is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "we" (نحن). ﴿مِنَ الْخاسِرِينَ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to its omitted khabar (predicate); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition not joined with the fāʾ … and the apodosis has made the answer to the oath unnecessary. It is also permissible to parse the clause لنكونن as the answer to the oath, the lām being the lām of the oath, and it has made the apodosis unnecessary.

daas-irab:134-134.t:
﴿وَلَمَّا﴾: a conditional adverb, and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِمُ الرِّجْزُ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and الرجز is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation). The clause ﴿قالُوا﴾ has no grammatical position, being the response to لما. ﴿يا مُوسَى﴾: the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative. ﴿ادْعُ لَنا رَبَّكَ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿لَنا﴾ are attached; the agent is "you"; ﴿رَبَّكَ﴾ is its object, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِما﴾: maṣdarī, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb ادع. Or ما is relative. ﴿عَهِدَ﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿عِنْدَكَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to the verb عهد. ﴿لَئِنْ﴾: the lām is the one that prepares for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); إن is a jussive conditional particle. ﴿كَشَفْتَ﴾: a past verb and agent. ﴿الرِّجْزُ﴾ [Translator's note: so vowelled in the source; as the object it is الرِّجْزَ]: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿عَنَّا﴾: attached to كشف. ﴿الرِّجْزُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: the source repeats this item]. ﴿لَنُؤْمِنَنَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥ because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; its agent is "we" (نحن), and the lām occurs in the response to the oath. ﴿لَكَ﴾: attached to the verb before them, and the clause occurs as the response to the oath. The clause كشف is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿لَنُرْسِلَنَّ﴾ is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مَعَكَ﴾: an adverb, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بَنِي﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; the nūn was dropped for annexation. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the fatḥa.

daas-irab:135-135.t:
﴿فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنا عَنْهُمُ الرِّجْزَ﴾: see the i'rab of the previous verse. ﴿إِلى أَجَلٍ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الرجز.
﴿هُمْ﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بالِغُوهُ﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation), and the nūn was dropped for annexation; the clause is in the position of the genitive as an adjective (ṣifa) of أجل. ﴿إِذا﴾: of surprise (al-fujāʾiyya). ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَنْكُثُونَ﴾: the clause is the khabar.

daas-irab:136-136.t:
﴿فَانْتَقَمْنا مِنْهُمْ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and نا is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined, and likewise the clause ﴿فَأَغْرَقْناهُمْ فِي الْيَمِّ﴾ "so We drowned them in the sea". ﴿بِأَنَّهُمْ﴾: anna, and the hāʾ is its noun. ﴿كَذَّبُوا﴾:
a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾ are attached; the wāw is its agent, and the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of anna. The interpreted maṣdar formed from anna, its noun and its khabar is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ: "We drowned them because of their denial ...". ﴿وَكانُوا﴾: kāna, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿عَنْها﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar ﴿غافِلِينَ﴾, and the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:137-137.t:
﴿وَأَوْرَثْنَا الْقَوْمَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first object. The clause is conjoined. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿يُسْتَضْعَفُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The clause is in the position of the accusative as khabar (predicate), and the clause كانوا يستضعفون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مَشارِقَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْأَرْضِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَمَغارِبَهَا﴾: conjoined to مشارق. ﴿الَّتِي﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as an adjective. ﴿بارَكْنا﴾: a past verb, and نا is its agent. ﴿فِيها﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) باركنا, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَتُ﴾: a past verb and its agent; the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْحُسْنى﴾: an adjective of كلمة, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied on the alif because of impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿عَلى﴾: a preposition. ﴿بَنِي﴾: a genitive noun, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural, and the nūn was dropped for annexation. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the fatḥa, a diptote because it is a proper noun and non-Arab. ﴿بِما﴾: ما is maṣdarī, interpreted together with the verb after it, ﴿صَبَرُوا﴾, as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb تمت.
﴿وَدَمَّرْنا﴾: a past verb and agent. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is conjoined.
﴿كانَ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿يَصْنَعُ فِرْعَوْنُ﴾: an imperfect verb and agent. ﴿وَقَوْمُهُ﴾: conjoined to فرعون. The clause is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of kāna.. and the clause of kāna with its noun and its khabar is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَما كانُوا يَعْرِشُونَ﴾: conjoined.

daas-irab:138-138.t:
﴿وَجاوَزْنا﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِبَنِي﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْبَحْرَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi [Translator's note: so in the source; البحر is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of جاوزنا].
﴿فَأَتَوْا عَلى قَوْمٍ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the wāw is its agent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَعْكُفُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and agent, and the clause is in the position of the genitive as an adjective (ṣifa) of قوم. ﴿عَلى أَصْنامٍ﴾: attached to the verb. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: attached to an omitted adjective of أصنام. ﴿قالُوا﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا مُوسَى﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿اجْعَلْ لَنا﴾: an imperative verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the agent is "you". ﴿إِلهاً﴾: its object. ﴿كَما﴾: the kāf is a preposition, and ما is maṣdarī or relative. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) ﴿آلِهَةٌ﴾. The interpreted maṣdar formed from ما and what follows it is in the position of the genitive by the kāf, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of إلها, i.e., "a worshipped god like their gods ....". ﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ﴾: inna and its noun [and khabar]; the clause إنكم قوم .. is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl), a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿تَجْهَلُونَ﴾: the clause is an adjective of قوم.

daas-irab:139-139.t:
﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasr, in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna. ﴿مُتَبَّرٌ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of متبر. ﴿هُمْ﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِيهِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. The nominal clause إنّ هؤلاء .. is resumptive. ﴿وَباطِلٌ﴾: a fronted khabar. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna and its noun, and the clause يعملون is in the position of the accusative as its khabar. The clause كانوا is the ṣila, with no grammatical position, and the nominal clause وباطل ما كانوا يعملون .. is conjoined.

daas-irab:140-140.t:
﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَغَيْرَ﴾: a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hamza is interrogative. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive. ﴿أَبْغِيكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ because of heaviness (thiqal). The kāf is genitive by removal of the preposition: "I seek for you". ﴿إِلهاً﴾: tamyīz (specification). The clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
The wāw is circumstantial. ﴿فَضَّلَكُمْ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عَلَى الْعالَمِينَ﴾ are attached, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he". The kāf is its object, and the verbal clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. The nominal clause وهو فضلكم is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:141-141.t:
In Sūrat al-Baqara, verse 49, it is نجيناكم instead of أنجيناكم .. and ويذبحون أبناءكم instead of يقتلون أبناءكم.
﴿وَإِذْ﴾: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember the time ....", and the clause is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation).
﴿يَسُومُونَكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, fāʿil (agent) and first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿سُوءَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْعَذابِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is circumstantial; the clause ﴿يُقَتِّلُونَ أَبْناءَكُمْ﴾ is a badal (substitute) of the clause ﴿يَسُومُونَكُمْ﴾. ﴿وَفِي ذلِكُمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) ﴿بَلاءٌ﴾. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾: attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of بلاء. ﴿عَظِيمٌ﴾: adjective, and the nominal clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:142-142.t:
﴿وَواعَدْنا مُوسى﴾: a past verb, fāʿil (agent) and first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ثَلاثِينَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَيْلَةً﴾: tamyīz (specification). The clause is resumptive. ﴿وَأَتْمَمْناها﴾: a past verb; نا is its agent and ها its object. ﴿بِعَشْرٍ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَتَمَّ مِيقاتُ رَبِّهِ﴾: a past verb and its agent. ﴿أَرْبَعِينَ﴾: its object [Translator's note: so in the source; تمّ is intransitive, and أربعين is commonly parsed as ḥāl], and the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَيْلَةً﴾: tamyīz.
﴿قالَ مُوسى﴾: a past verb and agent. ﴿لِأَخِيهِ﴾: a genitive noun, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is one of the five nouns.
The hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation). ﴿هارُونَ﴾: badal (substitute), genitive with the fatḥa in place of the kasra, a diptote because it is a proper noun and non-Arab; the clause is conjoined. ﴿اخْلُفْنِي﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the agent is implied as "you". ﴿فِي قَوْمِي﴾: attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَأَصْلِحْ﴾: conjoined to اخلف. ﴿وَلا تَتَّبِعْ﴾: the prohibitive lā and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā; the agent is "you". ﴿سَبِيلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿الْمُفْسِدِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:143-143.t:
﴿وَلَمَّا﴾: a conditional adverb, and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿جاءَ مُوسى لِمِيقاتِنا﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and موسى is its fāʿil (agent). The clause is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation). ﴿وَكَلَّمَهُ رَبُّهُ﴾: a past verb; the hāʾ is its object and ربّه its agent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb, and its agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive conditional. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative with the fatḥa implied on the letter before the first-person yāʾ. ﴿أَرِنِي﴾: a verb of supplication, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter because it is weak-final; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya).
