The yāʾ is its first object, and its second object is omitted, its implied form being "Yourself"; the agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you". ﴿أَنْظُرْ إِلَيْكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the response to the request; its agent is latent, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them; the response to the request together with its verb is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَنْ﴾: a particle governing the accusative. ﴿تَرانِي﴾: an accusative imperfect verb, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa implied on the alif, its appearance prevented by impossibility (taʿadhdhur); the nūn is for protection and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the speech reported. ﴿وَلكِنِ﴾: a particle of rectification (istidrāk), and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿انْظُرْ إِلَى الْجَبَلِ﴾: an imperative verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; its agent is "you", and the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَإِنِ﴾: إن is a jussive conditional, and the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿اسْتَقَرَّ﴾: a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿مَكانَهُ﴾: an adverb of place attached to استقر.
﴿فَسَوْفَ﴾: a particle of the future, and the fāʾ links the apodosis. ﴿تَرانِي﴾: a nominative imperfect verb, and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿فَلَمَّا تَجَلَّى رَبُّهُ لِلْجَبَلِ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is conditional; تجلى is a past verb with its agent, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿جَعَلَهُ دَكًّا﴾: a past verb and its two objects; the agent is "he", and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive conditional. ﴿وَخَرَّ مُوسى﴾: a past verb and agent. ﴿صَعِقاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَلَمَّا أَفاقَ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; لما is a jussive conditional [Translator's note: so in the source; elsewhere لما is described as a non-jussive conditional adverb], and [أفاق is] a past verb whose agent is latent. ﴿قالَ﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, being the response to لما. ﴿سُبْحانَكَ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, and the kāf is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿تُبْتُ﴾: a past verb and its agent. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: attached to تبت. The clause is the speech reported. ﴿وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

daas-irab:24-24.t:
﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿اهْبِطُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿بَعْضُكُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لِبَعْضٍ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to the khabar (predicate) ﴿عَدُوٌّ﴾; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلَكُمْ﴾: attached to an omitted khabar, and likewise the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾. ﴿مُسْتَقَرٌّ﴾: mubtadaʾ placed after. ﴿وَمَتاعٌ﴾: conjoined. ﴿إِلى حِينٍ﴾: attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of متاع, i.e. "provision extending until a time"; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:25-25.t:
﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِيها تَحْيَوْنَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, to which the preposition and its genitive noun before it are attached (mutaʿalliq); the wāw is its fāʿil (agent).
The clause is conjoined. ﴿وَفِيها تَمُوتُونَ وَمِنْها تُخْرَجُونَ﴾: conjoined.

daas-irab:26-26.t:
﴿يا بَنِي﴾: يا is a vocative particle; بني is a one addressed (munādā) in construct, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural, and the nūn has been dropped for the iḍāfa. ﴿آدَمَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa in place of the kasra, a non-Arabic proper name. ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَنْزَلْنا عَلَيْكُمْ لِباساً﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); نا is its fāʿil (agent) and لباسا its object; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يُوارِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ because of heaviness; the fāʿil is "it" (هو). ﴿سَوْآتِكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural; the clause is in the position of accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of لباس. ﴿وَرِيشاً﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَلِباسُ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); لباس is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿التَّقْوى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the kasra implied on the alif. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾: its khabar (predicate). The nominal clause ذلك خير is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ لباس. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْ آياتِ﴾: attached to its omitted khabar; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾: لعل, and the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿يَذَّكَّرُونَ﴾ is in the position of nominative as its khabar.
The clause ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:27-27.t:
﴿يا بَنِي آدَمَ﴾: its parsing was given in the previous verse. ﴿لا يَفْتِنَنَّكُمُ﴾: يفتننّ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and it is in the position of jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā; the kāf is its object and the mīm is for the masculine plural; ﴿الشَّيْطانُ﴾ is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿كَما﴾: the kāf is a preposition; ما is maṣdariyya (verbal-noun particle). ﴿أَخْرَجَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿أَبَوَيْكُمْ﴾: its object, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ; the nūn has been dropped for the iḍāfa, and the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb أخرج. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the maṣdariyya ما and the verb after it is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the kāf, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being: "let not Satan tempt you with a temptation like the temptation [of your parents]". ﴿يَنْزِعُ عَنْهُما لِباسَهُما﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and لباسهما is its object; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لِيُرِيَهُما﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the fāʿil is "he" (هو) and the hāʾ is its object; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl; and it is in the accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation. ﴿سَوْآتِهِما﴾: its second object, accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. The interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdariyya an and the verb after it is interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb ينزع. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna, and the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿يَراكُمْ﴾ is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of inna; the clause ﴿إِنَّهُ يَراكُمْ﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿هُوَ﴾: a detached nominative pronoun in the position of nominative as tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent pronoun in the verb يراكم. ﴿وَقَبِيلُهُ﴾: a noun conjoined to the nominative pronoun in يراكم. ﴿حَيْثُ﴾: an adverb of place, indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of genitive by a preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb يراكم. ﴿لا تَرَوْنَهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is its object; لا is negating; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّا﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿جَعَلْنَا الشَّياطِينَ أَوْلِياءَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its two objects; the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna. The clause ﴿إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا﴾ is causal, with no grammatical position.
﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾: attached to the verb جعلنا, and the clause ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:28-28.t: ﴿وَإِذا﴾: a conditional adverb, non-jussive; the wāw is resumptive. ﴿فَعَلُوا فاحِشَةً﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause ﴿قالُوا﴾ has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَجَدْنا عَلَيْها آباءَنا﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); نا is its fāʿil and آباءنا its object; the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl), a mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿أَمَرَنا بِها﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause ﴿اللَّهُ أَمَرَنا بِها﴾ is conjoined. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: inna, and the name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause ﴿لا يَأْمُرُ بِالْفَحْشاءِ﴾ is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as its khabar; the nominal clause ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ لا يَأْمُرُ﴾ is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَتَقُولُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hamza is for interrogation; the clause is the object of speech. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾: attached to the verb before it. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the clause ﴿لا تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:29-29.t:
﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَمَرَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿رَبِّي﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker; the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِالْقِسْطِ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to أمر. ﴿وَأَقِيمُوا وُجُوهَكُمْ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, with its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to أقيموا. ﴿كُلِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مَسْجِدٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَادْعُوهُ﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿مُخْلِصِينَ﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ. ﴿لَهُ﴾: attached to the active participle مخلصين before it.
﴿الدِّينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi of the active participle, whose fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿كَما﴾: the kāf is a preposition; ما is maṣdariyya (verbal-noun particle). ﴿بَدَأَكُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil being "He" (هو), and the kāf is its object; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the maṣdar-forming particle and the verb is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the kāf, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being: "you will return, a returning like His beginning of you".
The clause ﴿تَعُودُونَ﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:30-30.t: ﴿فَرِيقاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed before the verb ﴿هَدى﴾. The clause ﴿فَرِيقاً هَدى﴾ is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "guiding a party and leading astray a party". ﴿وَفَرِيقاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being "and He led astray" (وأضل); the clause is conjoined, and the clause ﴿حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الضَّلالَةُ﴾ is in the position of accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of فريق. ﴿إِنَّهُمُ﴾: inna, and the hāʾ is its noun. ﴿اتَّخَذُوا الشَّياطِينَ أَوْلِياءَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its two objects. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted adjective of أولياء; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the clause ﴿إِنَّهُمُ﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَيَحْسَبُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ مُهْتَدُونَ﴾: anna, its noun and its khabar, which have taken the place of the two objects of يحسبون.

daas-irab:31-31.t: ﴿يا بَنِي آدَمَ﴾: given in verse 25. [Translator's note: so in the source; the parsing was given in verse 26.] ﴿خُذُوا زِينَتَكُمْ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and ﴿زِينَتَكُمْ﴾ its object; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb before it. ﴿كُلِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مَسْجِدٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا﴾: conjoined to خذوا. ﴿وَلا تُسْرِفُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn because it is preceded by the prohibitive lā; the two clauses كلوا and لا تسرفوا are conjoined. The clause ﴿إِنَّهُ لا يُحِبُّ الْمُسْرِفِينَ﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿لا يُحِبُّ﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of inna.

daas-irab:32-32.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَنْ﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿حَرَّمَ زِينَةَ اللَّهِ﴾ is its khabar (predicate). ﴿الَّتِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as an adjective (ṣifa) of زينة, and the clause ﴿أَخْرَجَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَالطَّيِّباتِ﴾: conjoined to زينة, accusative with the kasra in place of the fatḥa, [being] a sound feminine plural. ﴿مِنَ الرِّزْقِ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿قُلْ﴾: its parsing has gone before. ﴿هِيَ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾: attached to the khabar, and the clause ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿فِي الْحَياةِ﴾: attached to the verb. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: an adjective of الحياة, genitive (majrūr) with the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif because it is impossible to pronounce. ﴿خالِصَةً﴾: a ḥāl, accusative. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to خالصة. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative in the position of genitive by the kāf; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun): "We detail the signs, a detailing like that". The clause ﴿نُفَصِّلُ﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ is an adjective.

daas-irab:33-33.t:
﴿قُلْ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّما﴾: [inna] restrained [by mā] and the restraining [mā] (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿حَرَّمَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). [Translator's note: so in the source, which then makes ربي the fāʿil.] ﴿رَبِّيَ﴾: the fāʿil of حرم, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker; the yāʾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْفَواحِشَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ما ظَهَرَ مِنْها﴾: ما is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a badal (substitute) from الفواحش, and the clause ظهر is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَما بَطَنَ﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَالْإِثْمَ وَالْبَغْيَ﴾: conjoined to الفواحش. ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to البغي. ﴿الْحَقِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿إِنَّما حَرَّمَ﴾ is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَأَنْ تُشْرِكُوا﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative by an, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is likewise conjoined: "my Lord has forbidden indecencies and polytheism".
﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: attached to تشركوا. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِ سُلْطاناً﴾: an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm), to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and سلطانا is its object; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَأَنْ تَقُولُوا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined, the implied form being: "He has forbidden polytheism and saying what you do not know". ﴿عَلَى﴾: a preposition. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the name of Majesty, in the position of genitive (majrūr); [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to the verb before them. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the clause ﴿لا تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ is its ṣila.

daas-irab:34-34.t: ﴿وَلِكُلِّ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first. ﴿أُمَّةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَجَلٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَإِذا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿إذا﴾: a conditional adverb, non-jussive, and the clause ﴿جاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ﴾ is in the position of genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿ساعَةً﴾: an adverb of time; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. The clause ﴿وَلا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ﴾ is conjoined.

daas-irab:35-35.t: ﴿يا بَنِي آدَمَ﴾: its parsing has gone before. ﴿إِمَّا﴾: إن is a jussive conditional particle, and ما is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿يَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, in the position of jussive (majzūm); the kāf is its object. ﴿رُسُلٌ﴾: its fāʿil (agent); the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿رُسُلٌ﴾; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَقُصُّونَ عَلَيْكُمْ آياتِي﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the wāw is its fāʿil, and آياتي its object, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra; the yāʾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as an adjective of رسل. ﴿فَمَنِ﴾: من is a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) [Translator's note: so in the source; the fāʾ in فمن connects the answer to the preceding إمّا, the whole of فمن اتقى… being that apodosis]. ﴿اتَّقى﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa, and it is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); likewise ﴿أَصْلَحَ﴾. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis, and لا is negating, without governing effect. ﴿خَوْفٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the clause ﴿فَمَنِ اتَّقى﴾ is resumptive. ﴿هُمْ﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿يَحْزَنُونَ﴾ is in the position of nominative as its khabar; the clause ﴿وَلا هُمْ﴾ is conjoined.

daas-irab:36-36.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَذَّبُوا بِآياتِنا﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the clause ﴿اسْتَكْبَرُوا عَنْها﴾ is conjoined. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on kasra, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَصْحابُ﴾: its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿أُولئِكَ أَصْحابُ النَّارِ﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ الذين. ﴿هُمْ﴾: a detached nominative pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾: attached to the khabar placed after, ﴿خالِدُونَ﴾; the nominal clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ is conjoined.
